text:
Also known as “liquid sunshine” ambrandy is a twice-fermented, distilled liquor of the highest calibre. Glitterworld aristocrats are known to send entire private militias to assist in shipping singular bottles.

Beyond being flavorful enough to bring one to tears, studies have found this liquor when deeply aged causes increased stimulation in the section of the human brain known for artistic creativity and expression while also dampening the section of the brain in control of emotions.

Even the bottle itself is a beauty to behold, when hit with even the tiniest amount of light golden flecks are seen dancing in the liquid within, like embers rising from a campfire. While Ambrandy can be mixed into cocktails, those few who have had the privilege to drink it say it is best on its own.

translated: 我已经在黑暗中呆了一段时间了。我喜欢它。

text: I don't really understand why everybody's so upset all the time.
protected_text: I don't really understand why everybody's so upset all the time.
translated: 我真的不明白为什么每个人总是如此沮丧。

text: [PAWN_nameDef] tends to occasionally allow their mind to drift, even in the middle of working.
protected_text: (PH_1) tends to occasionally allow their mind to drift, even in the middle of working.
translated: [PAWN_nameDef] 偶尔会走神，即使是在工作过程中。

text: [PAWN_nameDef] has a loose screw or two, a small trade off for being naturally scientifically inclined.
protected_text: (PH_1) has a loose screw or two, a small trade off for being naturally scientifically inclined.
translated: [PAWN_nameDef]有一两个松动的螺丝，为了自然的科学倾向而做出的一个小小的权衡。

text: [PAWN_nameDef] strives for perfection in [PAWN_possessive] work. They will naturally produce better quality products at the expense of time. However, making a low quality product will upset them. Additionally, they may very rarely quit a project mid attempt if they don't like the direction its going in.
protected_text: (PH_2) strives for perfection in (PH_1) work. They will naturally produce better quality products at the expense of time. However, making a low quality product will upset them. Additionally, they may very rarely quit a project mid attempt if they don't like the direction its going in.
translated: [PAWN_nameDef] 在 [PAWN_possessive] 工作中力求完美。他们自然会以牺牲时间为代价生产出质量更好的产品。然而，生产低质量的产品会让他们感到不安。此外，如果他们不喜欢项目的发展方向，他们很少会在尝试过程中退出项目。

text: While fully capable of warfare in theory, [PAWN_nameDef]'s fight or flight instincts heavily lean towards flight, and [PAWN_pronoun] will try to hide or run as a first priority.
protected_text: While fully capable of warfare in theory, (PH_2)'s fight or flight instincts heavily lean towards flight, and (PH_1) will try to hide or run as a first priority.
translated: 虽然理论上完全有能力进行战争，但 [PAWN_nameDef] 的战斗或逃跑本能严重倾向于飞行，并且 [PAWN_pronoun] 会首先尝试隐藏或逃跑。

text: [PAWN_nameDef] has a higher mental and physical fortitude compared to most and can more readily adapt to harsh environments in the rimworlds.
protected_text: (PH_1) has a higher mental and physical fortitude compared to most and can more readily adapt to harsh environments in the rimworlds.
translated: 与大多数人相比，[PAWN_nameDef] 具有更高的精神和身体毅力，更容易适应边缘世界的恶劣环境。

text: Minor bruises and scrapes plague [PAWN_nameDef] all too often, mostly due to uncoordinated tripping or falling.
protected_text: Minor bruises and scrapes plague (PH_1) all too often, mostly due to uncoordinated tripping or falling.
translated: [PAWN_nameDef] 经常会出现轻微的瘀伤和擦伤，主要是由于不协调的绊倒或跌倒造成的。

text: [PAWN_nameDef] loves the brightness and heat of a dry summer day. They don't mind working up a sweat or sleeping in the warmth either.
protected_text: (PH_1) loves the brightness and heat of a dry summer day. They don't mind working up a sweat or sleeping in the warmth either.
translated: [PAWN_nameDef] 喜欢干燥夏日的明亮和炎热。他们也不介意出汗或在温暖的地方睡觉。

text: [PAWN_nameDef] loves the overcast and cold of a brisk winter night. They don't mind getting chilly or sleeping in the cold either.
protected_text: (PH_1) loves the overcast and cold of a brisk winter night. They don't mind getting chilly or sleeping in the cold either.
translated: [PAWN_nameDef] 喜欢阴冷寒冷的冬夜。他们也不介意变冷或在寒冷中睡觉。

text: A bomb could go off next to [PAWN_nameDef] while they sleep and they'd continue to do so. They can't be bothered to defend the colony mid catnap, either.
protected_text: A bomb could go off next to (PH_1) while they sleep and they'd continue to do so. They can't be bothered to defend the colony mid catnap, either.
translated: 当他们睡觉时，炸弹可能会在 [PAWN_nameDef] 旁边爆炸，而且他们会继续这样做。他们也懒得在小睡中保卫殖民地。

text: [PAWN_nameDef] is naturally hygenic and organized. They will not track in dirt or throw trash anywhere, and feel happy while cleaning.
protected_text: (PH_1) is naturally hygenic and organized. They will not track in dirt or throw trash anywhere, and feel happy while cleaning.
translated: [PAWN_nameDef] 自然卫生且井井有条。他们不会在任何地方留下污垢或乱扔垃圾，并且在清洁时感到快乐。

text: [PAWN_nameDef] is sloppy naturally and leaves trash and dirt everywhere it seems. At least they're not much bothered by messes.
protected_text: (PH_1) is sloppy naturally and leaves trash and dirt everywhere it seems. At least they're not much bothered by messes.
translated: [PAWN_nameDef] 天生草率，看起来到处都是垃圾和污垢。至少他们不会被混乱所困扰。

text: [PAWN_nameDef] has problems taking breaks or resting mid job. [PAWN_pronoun] will continue to work even sacrificing their health or sleep.
protected_text: (PH_2) has problems taking breaks or resting mid job. (PH_1) will continue to work even sacrificing their health or sleep.
translated: [PAWN_nameDef] 在工作中休息或休息时遇到问题。 [PAWN_pronoun] 即使牺牲健康或睡眠也会继续工作。

text: [PAWN_nameDef] has never felt nausea in [PAWN_possessive] life. Throwing up or food poisoning is foreign to [PAWN_objective].
protected_text: (PH_3) has never felt nausea in (PH_2) life. Throwing up or food poisoning is foreign to (PH_1).
translated: [PAWN_nameDef] 一生中 [PAWN_possessive] 从未感到恶心。呕吐或食物中毒对 [PAWN_objective] 来说是陌生的。

text: [PAWN_nameDef] can't stand mistreatment of animals. [PAWN_pronoun] will feel happier being nuzzled or being a master to a bonded animal, but will be more deeply crushed when not master of a bonded animal or seeing one die. They also refuse to butcher.
protected_text: (PH_2) can't stand mistreatment of animals. (PH_1) will feel happier being nuzzled or being a master to a bonded animal, but will be more deeply crushed when not master of a bonded animal or seeing one die. They also refuse to butcher.
translated: [PAWN_nameDef] 无法忍受虐待动物。 [PAWN_pronoun] 被依偎或成为束缚动物的主人时会感到更快乐，但当不是束缚动物的主人或看到一只动物死亡时，会感到更深刻的打击。他们也拒绝屠宰。

text: [PAWN_nameDef] believes deeply in human superiority. Killing animals will please them and the colony losing an animal is a cherry on top according to them.
protected_text: (PH_1) believes deeply in human superiority. Killing animals will please them and the colony losing an animal is a cherry on top according to them.
translated: [PAWN_nameDef] 坚信人类的优越性。杀死动物会让他们感到高兴，而在他们看来，失去动物的殖民地是最重要的事情。

text: Whether because they're a bit chunky or because they shift their weight oddly, [PAWN_nameDef] has broken a few chairs in their time and is likely to break more.
protected_text: Whether because they're a bit chunky or because they shift their weight oddly, (PH_1) has broken a few chairs in their time and is likely to break more.
translated: 无论是因为它们有点矮胖，还是因为它们的重量转移得很奇怪，[PAWN_nameDef] 曾经拥有 坏掉 几把椅子，而且很可能会坏掉更多。

text: [PAWN_nameDef] only plays by their own rules, and will roll their eyes and take it easy while doing any task they've been forced to do.
protected_text: (PH_1) only plays by their own rules, and will roll their eyes and take it easy while doing any task they've been forced to do.
translated: [PAWN_nameDef] 只按照自己的规则行事，并且会翻白眼，轻松地完成他们 被迫 要做的任何任务。

text: [PAWN_nameDef] needs clear instructions on how, and when to do certain things and will only work at a normal speed when being forced to do something.
protected_text: (PH_1) needs clear instructions on how, and when to do certain things and will only work at a normal speed when being forced to do something.
translated: [PAWN_nameDef] 需要关于如何以及何时做某些事情的明确指示，并且只有在 被迫 做某事时才会以正常速度工作。

text: [PAWN_nameDef] is fueled by spite. They can't stand walking on the same soil as their rivals and will be elated by news of their life ending.
protected_text: (PH_1) is fueled by spite. They can't stand walking on the same soil as their rivals and will be elated by news of their life ending.
translated: [PAWN_nameDef] 是由怨恨助长的。他们无法忍受与对手走在同一块土地上，并会因自己生命终结的消息而感到高兴。

text: Whether by past trauma or fear of change, [PAWN_nameDef] rejects modernity. They may randomly punch or attack mechanical devices and refuse to learn or research anything about them. They also love killing mechanoids.
protected_text: Whether by past trauma or fear of change, (PH_1) rejects modernity. They may randomly punch or attack mechanical devices and refuse to learn or research anything about them. They also love killing mechanoids.
translated: 无论是过去的创伤还是对变化的恐惧，[PAWN_nameDef] 拒绝现代性。他们可能会随机殴打或攻击机械设备，并​​拒绝学习或研究有关它们的任何信息。他们也喜欢杀死机械人。

text: [PAWN_nameDef] always recalls the good times and lives to party, any party attended will be remembered for many times longer than most.
protected_text: (PH_1) always recalls the good times and lives to party, any party attended will be remembered for many times longer than most.
translated: [PAWN_nameDef]总是会回忆起聚会的美好时光和生活，任何参加过的聚会都会比大多数人更长久地被记住。

text: [PAWN_nameDef] has hindered mental capacities. While slow to learn and hard to speak with, they tend to be much happier naturally.
protected_text: (PH_1) has hindered mental capacities. While slow to learn and hard to speak with, they tend to be much happier naturally.
translated: [PAWN_nameDef] 阻碍了心智能力。虽然他们学得慢、很难沟通，但他们自然会更快乐。

text: [PAWN_nameDef] learned a specific move in melee combat which allows them to disarm opponents and will use it frequently.
protected_text: (PH_1) learned a specific move in melee combat which allows them to disarm opponents and will use it frequently.
translated: [PAWN_nameDef] 学会了近战战斗中的特定动作，可以让他们解除对手的武装，并且会经常使用它。

text: [PAWN_nameDef] believes they belong in high society, and loves nothing more than critiquing art and brushing elbows with royalty.
protected_text: (PH_1) believes they belong in high society, and loves nothing more than critiquing art and brushing elbows with royalty.
translated: [PAWN_nameDef] 认为自己属于上流社会，最喜欢批评艺术和与皇室接触。

text: Sour stomach plagues [PAWN_nameDef] any time they're around too much blood or rotting corpses. Vomiting is just part of life for {PAWN_objective}.
protected_text: Sour stomach plagues (PH_2) any time they're around too much blood or rotting corpses. Vomiting is just part of life for (PH_1).
translated: 每当他们周围有太多血或腐烂尸体时，胃酸就会困扰[PAWN_nameDef]。呕吐只是 {PAWN_objective} 生活的一部分。

text: [PAWN_nameDef] feels naturally anxious, but especially from social situations. They will not attend any gatherings and may occasionally need alone time in their room to breathe.
protected_text: (PH_1) feels naturally anxious, but especially from social situations. They will not attend any gatherings and may occasionally need alone time in their room to breathe.
translated: [PAWN_nameDef] 自然地感到焦虑，尤其是在社交场合。他们不会参加任何聚会，有时可能需要在房间里独处喘口气。

text: No amount of lovin' is enough lovin' for [PAWN_nameDef]. [PAWN_pronoun] will tend to jump from partner to partner and tumble between the sheets with them frequently.
protected_text: No amount of lovin' is enough lovin' for (PH_2). (PH_1) will tend to jump from partner to partner and tumble between the sheets with them frequently.
translated: 对 [PAWN_nameDef] 的爱再多也不够。 [PAWN_pronoun] 会倾向于从一个伙伴跳到另一个伙伴，并经常与他们一起在床单之间翻滚。

text: [PAWN_nameDef] refuses to give their body to anybody but their spouse and would never fathom initiating a divorce. They also hate being nude much more than other pawns.
protected_text: (PH_1) refuses to give their body to anybody but their spouse and would never fathom initiating a divorce. They also hate being nude much more than other pawns.
translated: [PAWN_nameDef] 拒绝将自己的身体交给配偶以外的任何人，并且永远不会提出离婚。他们也比其他棋子更讨厌裸体。

text: An armchair and flatscreen is all [PAWN_nameDef] needs to be happy. Even reruns or ancient commercials are entertaining to them, they will never grow bored of television and tend to watch it more, as well as feel pleased after doing so.
protected_text: An armchair and flatscreen is all (PH_1) needs to be happy. Even reruns or ancient commercials are entertaining to them, they will never grow bored of television and tend to watch it more, as well as feel pleased after doing so.
translated: 扶手椅和平板电视就是 [PAWN_nameDef] 快乐所需要的一切。即使重播或古老的广告对他们来说都是有趣的，他们永远不会对电视感到厌倦，并且倾向于看更多，并且看后感到高兴。

text: [PAWN_nameDef] is mad for all things feline. They will naturally gravitate towards bonding with cats, however they're not a fan of dogs.
protected_text: (PH_1) is mad for all things feline. They will naturally gravitate towards bonding with cats, however they're not a fan of dogs.
translated: [PAWN_nameDef] 对所有猫科动物都很着迷。他们自然会倾向于与猫建立联系，但他们不喜欢狗。

text: [PAWN_nameDef] is mad for all things canine. They will naturally gravitate towards bonding with dogs, however they're not a fan of cats.
protected_text: (PH_1) is mad for all things canine. They will naturally gravitate towards bonding with dogs, however they're not a fan of cats.
translated: [PAWN_nameDef] 对所有与狗相关的事物感到疯狂。他们自然会倾向于与狗建立联系，但他们不喜欢猫。

text: [PAWN_nameDef] is a natural scientist. They research much faster and recall things better. However, they'll be upset without a laboratory dedicated to their work and tend to stress out more frequently.
protected_text: (PH_1) is a natural scientist. They research much faster and recall things better. However, they'll be upset without a laboratory dedicated to their work and tend to stress out more frequently.
translated: [PAWN_nameDef] 是一位自然科学家。他们的研究速度更快，记忆力也更好。然而，如果没有专门从事他们工作的实验室，他们会感到不安，并且往往会更频繁地感到压力。

text: [PAWN_nameDef] believes animals are integral to the way society and life functions from furry friends to sources of food. They love having as many as possible and are particularly good at taming and training them.
protected_text: (PH_1) believes animals are integral to the way society and life functions from furry friends to sources of food. They love having as many as possible and are particularly good at taming and training them.
translated: [PAWN_nameDef] 相信动物是社会和生活不可或缺的一部分，从 拟人化的动物角色，具有人的个性与特点。的 朋友到食物来源。他们喜欢拥有尽可能多的动物，并且特别擅长驯服和训练它们。

text: The sea calls to [PAWN_nameDef]. [PAWN_pronoun] feels happier just being near the ocean or a deep river.
protected_text: The sea calls to (PH_2). (PH_1) feels happier just being near the ocean or a deep river.
translated: 大海在召唤 [PAWN_nameDef]。 [PAWN_pronoun] 靠近海洋或深河会感觉更快乐。

text: The mountains call to [PAWN_nameDef]. [PAWN_pronoun] feels happier just being near a large mountain.
protected_text: The mountains call to (PH_2). (PH_1) feels happier just being near a large mountain.
translated: 群山呼唤[PAWN_nameDef]。 [PAWN_pronoun] 靠近一座大山就会感觉更快乐。

text: [PAWN_nameDef] has a twisted secret. [PAWN_pronoun] treats organ harvesting like a sick experiment, and does not even blink at the idea. While harvesting one will make them happy, going too long without giving in to their compulsion will upset them.
protected_text: (PH_2) has a twisted secret. (PH_1) treats organ harvesting like a sick experiment, and does not even blink at the idea. While harvesting one will make them happy, going too long without giving in to their compulsion will upset them.
translated: [PAWN_nameDef] 有一个扭曲的秘密。 [PAWN_pronoun] 将器官摘取视为一个病态的实验，甚至对这个想法都不眨眼。虽然收获一颗会让他们高兴，但长时间不屈服于他们的冲动会让他们心烦意乱。

text: [PAWN_nameDef] is supposedly a hand-to-hand combat specialist, but only when inebriated. They claim to become more talented the more drunk they are.
protected_text: (PH_1) is supposedly a hand-to-hand combat specialist, but only when inebriated. They claim to become more talented the more drunk they are.
translated: [PAWN_nameDef] 据称是肉搏战专家，但仅限于喝醉时。他们声称喝醉越多就越有才华。

text: [PAWN_nameDef] is compulsed to steal and take things that don't belong to them, even if it means angering the other party.
protected_text: (PH_1) is compulsed to steal and take things that don't belong to them, even if it means angering the other party.
translated: [PAWN_nameDef] 被迫偷窃和拿走不属于自己的东西，即使这意味着激怒对方。

text: Smokeleaf culture is just part of life for [PAWN_nameDef]. [PAWN_pronoun] absolutely adores smokeleaf and would rather die before giving it up.
protected_text: Smokeleaf culture is just part of life for (PH_2). (PH_1) absolutely adores smokeleaf and would rather die before giving it up.
translated: Smokeleaf 文化只是 [PAWN_nameDef] 生活的一部分。 [PAWN_pronoun] 非常喜欢烟叶，宁愿死也不放弃它。

text: Alcohol culture is just part of life for [PAWN_nameDef]. [PAWN_pronoun] absolutely adores booze and would rather die before giving it up.
protected_text: Alcohol culture is just part of life for (PH_2). (PH_1) absolutely adores booze and would rather die before giving it up.
translated: 酒精文化只是 [PAWN_nameDef] 生活的一部分。 [PAWN_pronoun] 绝对喜欢喝酒，宁愿死也不戒酒。

text: [PAWN_nameDef] loves to travel and does so swiftly, but can grow upset if they haven't done so in a while. They are also quite adept at foraging while traveling.
protected_text: (PH_1) loves to travel and does so swiftly, but can grow upset if they haven't done so in a while. They are also quite adept at foraging while traveling.
translated: [PAWN_nameDef] 喜欢旅行，而且旅行速度很快，但如果他们有一段时间没有旅行，就会感到不安。它们也非常擅长在旅行时觅食。

text: [PAWN_nameDef] is never really asleep or awake. [PAWN_pronoun] is almost zombie like, lurching along and working very slowly, and will only sleep once every three days or so.
protected_text: (PH_2) is never really asleep or awake. (PH_1) is almost zombie like, lurching along and working very slowly, and will only sleep once every three days or so.
translated: [PAWN_nameDef] 从未真正睡着或醒着。 [PAWN_pronoun] 几乎像僵尸一样，摇摇晃晃地前进，工作速度非常缓慢，大约每三天才睡一次。

text: [PAWN_nameDef] has grown tired of the world and needs to be constantly distracted to stop dark thoughts. [PAWN_possessive] bleak personality is a big downer and therefore it is very hard to become friends with them.
protected_text: (PH_2) has grown tired of the world and needs to be constantly distracted to stop dark thoughts. (PH_1) bleak personality is a big downer and therefore it is very hard to become friends with them.
translated: [PAWN_nameDef]已经厌倦了这个世界，需要不断地分散注意力到停止黑暗的想法上。 [PAWN_possessive] 阴郁的性格让人很沮丧，因此很难与他们成为朋友。

text: [PAWN_nameDef] is hardened through what can only be presumed as old emotional trauma. They feel absolutely nothing from lost animals, colonists, family, prisoners or dead bodies.
protected_text: (PH_1) is hardened through what can only be presumed as old emotional trauma. They feel absolutely nothing from lost animals, colonists, family, prisoners or dead bodies.
translated: [PAWN_nameDef] 因只能被认为是旧的情感创伤而变得坚强。他们对失踪的动物、殖民者、家人、囚犯或尸体毫无感觉。

text: Only the finest of culinary creations may grace the lips of [PAWN_nameDef]. They feel neutral towards mundane meals, but will laud and savour lavish meals down to the last bite.
protected_text: Only the finest of culinary creations may grace the lips of (PH_1). They feel neutral towards mundane meals, but will laud and savour lavish meals down to the last bite.
translated: 只有最精美的烹饪作品才能为 [PAWN_nameDef] 的嘴唇增光添彩。他们对平凡的食物感到中立，但会称赞并品尝丰盛的食物直到最后一口。

text: Whether through studying ancient manuscripts or years of scholastic pursuit [PAWN_nameDef] is surprisingly well read on a variety of topics, particularly science and medical practice.
protected_text: Whether through studying ancient manuscripts or years of scholastic pursuit (PH_1) is surprisingly well read on a variety of topics, particularly science and medical practice.
translated: 无论是通过研究古代手稿还是多年的学术追求，[PAWN_nameDef] 在各种主题上的阅读量都令人惊讶，尤其是科学和医学实践。

text: [PAWN_nameDef] strongly believes infrastucture rules all and is a natural born stoneworker.
protected_text: (PH_1) strongly believes infrastucture rules all and is a natural born stoneworker.
translated: [PAWN_nameDef] 坚信基础设施决定一切，并且是天生的石匠。

text: In the eyes of [PAWN_nameDef] food is art, their culinary creations are incredibly beautiful, amazing to taste, and almost always safe to eat.
protected_text: In the eyes of (PH_1) food is art, their culinary creations are incredibly beautiful, amazing to taste, and almost always safe to eat.
translated: 在 [PAWN_nameDef] 的眼中，食物就是艺术，他们的烹饪作品非常美丽，味道令人惊叹，而且几乎总是可以安全食用。

text: Flora and fauna are both vital to [PAWN_nameDef]. They use all parts of plants and animals and strongly appreciate mother Gaia's blessings.
protected_text: Flora and fauna are both vital to (PH_1). They use all parts of plants and animals and strongly appreciate mother Gaia's blessings.
translated: 植物群和动物群对 [PAWN_nameDef] 都至关重要。他们使用植物和动物的所有部分，并强烈感谢母亲盖亚的祝福。

text: [PAWN_nameDef] has an eye for silver and a tongue made from it. They believe their products are the best products and [PAWN_pronoun] will likely convince you if given the chance.
protected_text: (PH_2) has an eye for silver and a tongue made from it. They believe their products are the best products and (PH_1) will likely convince you if given the chance.
translated: [PAWN_nameDef] 有一双银眼和由银制成的舌头。他们相信他们的产品是最好的产品，如果有机会的话，[PAWN_pronoun] 很可能会说服您。

text: [PAWN_nameDef] is strangely hypercoagulating and will bleed much more slowly than most.
protected_text: (PH_1) is strangely hypercoagulating and will bleed much more slowly than most.
translated: [PAWN_nameDef] 奇怪地处于高凝状态，并且出血速度比大多数情况慢得多。

text: [PAWN_nameDef] is strangely hemophilic and tends to bleed much more profusely than others.
protected_text: (PH_1) is strangely hemophilic and tends to bleed much more profusely than others.
translated: [PAWN_nameDef] 患有奇怪的血友病，并且比其他人流血更多。

text: [PAWN_nameDef] has trouble expressing themselves until its all too much to bear, whereafter they will have an utter meltdown.

亚热带常绿阔叶乔木。它的叶子是革质的，呈矛状，上面是深绿色的，下面是银色的，在树枝上彼此相对。木材不易腐烂。如果顶部枯死，根部通常会长出新的树干。

text:
A palm tree cultivated extensively in tropical areas for its edible fruit, the coconut. Coconut palms flourish best close to the sea on low-lying areas a few feet above high water.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All fruit trees take about four times as much space as regular crops, take a long time to grow and produce fruits that can be eaten raw. They aren't destroyed after harvesting but have a limited lifespan and will eventually need to be replanted.

Coconut palms are only growable in sandy growing zones, which ignore fertility. These plants will however take a long time to sow and harvest, basically exchanging colonist work for growing plants in a normally unused space.

Coconut palms receive a growth bonus if sea water tiles are found in a 6 tile radius. Coconuts can be used as fruits or processed into milk.

translated:
一种在热带地区广泛种植的棕榈树，其果实可食用，即椰子。椰子树在靠近大海、海拔几英尺的低洼地区最为茂盛。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color>所有果树所占用的空间大约是普通作物的四倍，需要很长时间才能生长并结出可以生吃的水果。它们在收获后不会被破坏，但寿命有限，最终需要重新种植。

椰子树只能在沙质生长区生长，而忽略了肥力。然而，这些植物需要很长时间才能播种和收获，基本上是用殖民者的工作来换取在通常未使用的空间中种植植物。

如果在 6 格半径内发现海水格，椰子树将获得生长奖励。椰子可用作水果或加工成牛奶。

text:
A deciduous tree cultivated for its fruit, almonds. The sweet almond can be eaten plain or be used as ingredient in desserts and confectioneries. The trees are strikingly beautiful when in flower; they produce fragrant, five-petaled, light pink to white flowers.

Almond trees are beautiful, but they require water to be present in a 6 tile radius to grow properly. Almonds can be used as fruits or processed into milk.

text:
A loose confederation of pirate gangs who've agreed to mostly fight outsiders instead of fighting each other.
Pirates don't sow, they don't build, and they rarely trade. Driven by a blood-and-honor culture that values personal strength and ruthlessness, they enrich themselves by raiding and robbing their more productive neighbors.
Junkers utilise warcasket technology and seal themselves in metal tombs in which they raid, steal, plunder and inevitably die. They rarely use melee weapons and prefer to keep at distance to the enemy to fully utilise the powerful warcasket weaponry.

一个由海盗团伙组成的松散联盟，他们同意主要与外来者战斗，而不是互相战斗。

As the ship entered the lower orbit, something struck the hull with tremendous force. Not sure if it was the AI-core miscalculation, a terrible accident or a targeted strike, you quickly realized it doesn’t matter. You ordered your crew to get in the escape pods, but not everyone managed to get out of cryptosleep in time. The ship split into numerous chunks as it quickly descended onto the surface, and the only thing you could have done is hit the Eject button on the emergency drop pod. Perhaps some things can still be recovered from the wreckage.

Note: Since you start crash landing and with no supplies other than what you can scavenge, this is a difficult scenario.

text:
A complex foundry with four operating arms designed to assist an operator in mounting a person into the frame of a warcasket. Once they are locked in, the pilot cannot leave until the procedure is finished.

To begin, an operator starts linking them to the suit - their nerves and limbs permanently linked to the frame. Since the warcasket is not designed to register wear or damage they will feel no pain. The pilot can exit the foundry only when the final rivet is placed, the last plate is welded, and the power system is brought online. Until then they will need external help such as feeding as they are effectively buried alive.

Because the various parts of the warcasket are welded onto the frame as a single, homogenous entity,  one can mix and match various designs to suit the situation but certain later generations of warcaskets function better if they are part of the same series.

首先，操作员开始将它们连接到宇航服上 - 他们的神经和四肢永久连接到框架上。由于战棺的设计不是为了记录磨损或损坏，因此他们不会感到疼痛。只有当最后一个铆钉被放置、最后一块板被焊接并且电力系统上线时，飞行员才能离开铸造厂。在此之前，它们将需要外部帮助，例如喂食，因为它们实际上是被活埋的。

由于战棺的各个部分作为一个单一的同质实体焊接到框架上，因此可以混合搭配各种设计以适应情况，但某些后续版本的战棺如果属于同一系列，则功能会更好。

第 10 代战棺实际上是根据缴获的海盗装备改编的，政府军事研究部门通过先进的动力装甲设计对其进行了改进。为了获得更多的优质资源，并将这些资源装备到原本无法服役的退伍军人身上，该计划创建了单用户操作的无畏舰。盔甲的多功能性得到了改进，通常减少了对不同盔甲系列甚至跨代的混合件的限制。

石棺系列是一个极其敏感的问题，因为它引发了关于其使用的无数争论和骚乱。这是因为它可以让飞行员在本来应该死亡的情况下保持良好的功能，因此不仅被用于退伍军人，而且还被用于囚犯、残疾人和契约仆人，他们的死亡权利实际上被驳回了。一般来说，一旦有人融入了这个装甲系列，他们就会留在里面，直到被彻底摧毁。

text:
Specialized spacer-tech warcasket helmet with standard protection, equipped with a discharge module which feeds from the shields’ capacitors.

10th generation warcaskets were actually adapted from captured pirate rigs, with government military research divisions improving them with advanced power armour designs. Access to a greater amount of high quality resources and the objective of equipping them onto combat veterans that would otherwise be unable to serve meant the program created single-user operated dreadnoughts. The versatility of the armours have been improved, generally reducing restrictions on mixing pieces of different armour series even across generations.

The Brute series is equipped with one of the most advanced shield modules available along with numerous oversized capacitors. Unique to this series, the shields lack the ability to allow the user to fire ranged weapons, but makes up for it by additionally blocking melee as well as ranged attacks. Due to the excessive number of capacitors, the recharge rate for the shields is particularly slow. As such, a Brute should go into melee and kill everything in one go, even detonating their shields if they don’t put themselves in immediate danger.

第七代战棺在进一步提高基准性能方面取得了令人印象深刻的成绩，转而专注于创造可互换的设计，作为一个整体效果更好。他们也是第一个在设计中加入塑料钢的人，因为它更频繁地出现在拾荒和抢劫中。每件产品都具有与同系列产品协同作用的独特功能，使它们成为真正独立的班级移动装甲单位。

Barrage系列对Cataphract系列进行了大量补充，包括更重的装甲板和从海军舰艇“批量借用”的武器平台稳定器。其目标是在忽略敌方来袭火力的同时，将尽可能多的火力投入到射程内，他们的口号是“躲避”。

text:
Specialized warcasket shell with peerless environment protection for similar weight, fitted with flame retardant material.

The 7th generation warcaskets came after underwhelming results in improving the baseline performance even further, instead focusing on creating designs that - while interchangeable - work better as a set. They were also the first to include plasteel in the design as it appeared more frequently in scavenging and looting. Each piece has a unique function that synergises with those of the same series, making them a truly separate class of mobile armor units.

The Hazard series was arguably one of the first of the 7th gen warcaskets, and was designed with utility in mind. The pilot can comfortably walk through a blazing inferno and excessive radiation, either when scavenging the remains of a battle or making its way to overload a ship’s nuclear reactor. Ironically, these pilots’ favourite saying is “I love the smell of napalm, it smells like money”.

text:
A large, bulky suit that allows the wearer to passively produce Rum once every 10 days. However, it is not very pleasant to wear as it feels like wearing damp, humid clothes from excessive sweating.

The suit includes a high-efficiency filter, heat-exchange filaments and salt precipitators. Urine and feces are processed in thigh pads and throughout the design are tubes that link to different catchpockets. Reprocessed bodily fluids are distilled into an alcoholic derivative of nutrient paste which can be drained when all the pockets are filled.

Removing the suit causes the accumulated liquid to evaporate, and it takes a long time to put on and properly adjust to the wearer. Due to the design, it can only be worn with an undersuit and the lack of head covering, while reducing efficiency, is purposefully done so it can be worn with head protection.

text:
Specialized spacer-tech warcasket shell with standard protection, augmented with improved shield capacitors for greater durability.

10th generation warcaskets were actually adapted from captured pirate rigs, with government military research divisions improving them with advanced power armour designs. Access to a greater amount of high quality resources and the objective of equipping them onto combat veterans that would otherwise be unable to serve meant the program created single-user operated dreadnoughts. The versatility of the armours have been improved, generally reducing restrictions on mixing pieces of different armour series even across generations.

The Siegebreaker series provides a general focus on stronger ranged shields to improve survivability in the field, whether that be improving the capacitors or the charging conduits. Because it is a relatively simple improvement, this series is suited more for laying down masses of firepower downrange while offering excellent protection so one can freely reposition to flank the enemy.

text: animistFact(tag=meme_Aristocratic)     ->The spirits value those of pure blood above the rest, for those who can command others in life are also proving the strength of their spirit.

text: serketistProphecy(tag=meme_Aristocratic)->As ants and bees have their queens and their drones, so shall we organize our societies: one of noble blood reigning supreme over his or her subjects.
mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures
protected_text: (PH_1)->As ants and bees have their queens and their drones, so shall we organize our societies: one of noble blood reigning supreme over his or her subjects.

text: chthonianProphecy(tag=meme_Aristocratic)->Our leaders of noble blood will protect us and shield us from the cosmic insanity of these terrible beings. Only by obeying them can we hope to stay sane.

text: esotericismProphecy(tag=meme_Aristocratic)->The noble blood of our leaders will allow them to see beyond the veil. Secrets that are to be forever hidden from their humble servants.

protected_text: (PH_1)In the unknown vastness of space, there are insane entities that could remake the whole Universe with a simple wayward thought.
translated: chthonianBasis   ->在未知的浩瀚空间中，存在着一些疯狂的实体，它们可以通过简单任性的想法重塑整个宇宙。

text: chthonianFact    ->We are like insects to these entities. Not even worthy of their attention. As insignificant to them as an ant would be to us.
mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures
protected_text: (PH_1)We are like insects to these entities. Not even worthy of their attention. As insignificant to them as an ant would be to us.
translated: chthonianFact    ->对于这些实体来说，我们就像昆虫。甚至不值得他们关注。对于他们来说，就像一只蚂蚁对于我们来说是微不足道的。

text: chthonianFact    ->They do not care about humanity. We are nothing to them. Not even a footnote.
mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures
protected_text: (PH_1)They do not care about humanity. We are nothing to them. Not even a footnote.
translated: chthonianFact    ->他们不关心人性。我们对他们来说什么都不是。连脚注都没有。

text: chthonianFact    ->Though powerful, they are uncaring. So far beyond our intelligence that we are not even sapient in their eyes.
mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures
protected_text: (PH_1)Though powerful, they are uncaring. So far beyond our intelligence that we are not even sapient in their eyes.
translated: chthonianFact    ->虽然强大，但他们漠不关心。远远超出了我们的智力，在他们眼里我们甚至算不上聪明。

text: chthonianFact    ->From their point of view, we don't even exist. The same way you don't think about the microbes in the surface of the chair you are sitting on.
mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures
protected_text: (PH_1)From their point of view, we don't even exist. The same way you don't think about the microbes in the surface of the chair you are sitting on.
translated: chthonianFact    ->从他们的角度来看，我们甚至不存在。就像你不会考虑你所坐的椅子表面的微生物一样。

text: chthonianProphecy->[weMustBe] careful, for it wouldn't be wise to attract their attention, as they could destroy us in an instant.
mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures
protected_text: (PH_2)(PH_1) careful, for it wouldn't be wise to attract their attention, as they could destroy us in an instant.
translated: chthonianProphecy->[weMustBe]小心，因为吸引他们的注意力并不明智，因为他们可能会在瞬间内摧毁我们。

text: chthonianProphecy->[byWorshipping] them, perhaps we can avoid their gaze.
mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures
protected_text: (PH_2)(PH_1) them, perhaps we can avoid their gaze.
translated: chthonianProphecy->[byWorshipping]他们，也许我们可以避开他们的目光。

text: chthonianProphecy->Don't be fooled: they don't deserve our devotion. But perhaps by showing a false façade of piety we can avoid their attention long enough.
mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures
protected_text: (PH_1)Don't be fooled: they don't deserve our devotion. But perhaps by showing a false façade of piety we can avoid their attention long enough.
translated: chthonianProphecy->不要被愚弄：他们不值得我们奉献。但也许通过表现出虔诚的虚假外表，我们可以足够长时间地避免他们的注意。

text: chthonianProphecy->Even so, a lot can be learned from them. Eldritch knowledge awaits those brave -or foolish- enough to peek into the screaming visage of madness.
mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures
protected_text: (PH_1)Even so, a lot can be learned from them. Eldritch knowledge awaits those brave -or foolish- enough to peek into the screaming visage of madness.
translated: chthonianProphecy->即便如此，我们还是可以从他们身上学到很多东西。可怕的知识等待着那些勇敢——或者愚蠢——的人来窥探疯狂的尖叫面孔。

mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures

text: esotericismBasis   ->Beyond the grasp of common science, there is an unsurpassed wealth of secret knowledge.
mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures
protected_text: (PH_1)Beyond the grasp of common science, there is an unsurpassed wealth of secret knowledge.
translated: esotericismBasis   ->除了常识之外，还有无比丰富的秘密知识。

text: esotericismBasis   ->Hidden to the prying eyes of scientists and philosophers, an occult world of hidden knowledge awaits.
mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures
protected_text: (PH_1)Hidden to the prying eyes of scientists and philosophers, an occult world of hidden knowledge awaits.
translated: esotericismBasis   ->在科学家和哲学家的窥探之下，一个充满隐藏知识的神秘世界正在等待着他们。

text: esotericismBasis   ->Science can only bring you so far. Beyond the veil of reality there is a trove of secret knowledge, waiting to be uncovered.
mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures
protected_text: (PH_1)Science can only bring you so far. Beyond the veil of reality there is a trove of secret knowledge, waiting to be uncovered.
translated: esotericismBasis   ->科学只能带您到目前为止。在现实的面纱之外，还有大量的秘密知识等待着我们去揭开。

text: esotericismBasis   ->The Universe is too vast to be limited to the constraints of pure math and physics. Beyond such human limitations there is a vast treasure of secret knowledge that can be accessed by those willing to do so at any cost necessary.
mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures
protected_text: (PH_1)The Universe is too vast to be limited to the constraints of pure math and physics. Beyond such human limitations there is a vast treasure of secret knowledge that can be accessed by those willing to do so at any cost necessary.
translated: esotericismBasis   ->宇宙太大了，无法受到纯数学和物理的限制。除了人类的这些限制之外，还有大量的秘密知识宝藏可供那些愿意不惜一切代价获取的人使用。

text: esotericismFact    ->Only a select few have the mental strength to acquire such insights.
mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures
protected_text: (PH_1)Only a select few have the mental strength to acquire such insights.
translated: esotericismFact    ->只有少数人有足够的精神力量获得这样的见解。

text: esotericismFact    ->These occult insights are not for everyone. Only a small group of sages can explore and observe them. The Chosen Ones.
mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures
protected_text: (PH_1)These occult insights are not for everyone. Only a small group of sages can explore and observe them. The Chosen Ones.
translated: esotericismFact    ->这些神秘的见解并不适合所有人。只有一小部分圣人能够探索和观察它们。被选中的人。

text: esotericismFact    ->Such insights would probably be too much for the common folk. Only those with great mental fortitude can peer into the occult... and keep their minds intact.
mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures
protected_text: (PH_1)Such insights would probably be too much for the common folk. Only those with great mental fortitude can peer into the occult... and keep their minds intact.
translated: esotericismFact    ->这样的见解对于普通人来说可能太多了。只有那些具有强大精神毅力的人才能洞察神秘……并保持头脑完整。

text: esotericismProphecy->Perhaps by delving into such knowledge we can even trascend our mortal existence.
mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures
protected_text: (PH_1)Perhaps by delving into such knowledge we can even trascend our mortal existence.
translated: esotericismProphecy->也许通过深入研究这些知识，我们甚至可以超越我们的凡人存在。

text: esotericismProphecy->Given enough time, we will crack the most guarded secrets, and finally understand our place in this Universe.
mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures
protected_text: (PH_1)Given enough time, we will crack the most guarded secrets, and finally understand our place in this Universe.
translated: esotericismProphecy->只要有足够的时间，我们将破解最保守的秘密，并最终了解我们在这个宇宙中的位置。

text: esotericismProphecy->The alchemists of antiquity might not have been so foolish in their search for gold, but we are much more ambitious: we will apply the transmundane to our very souls and become more than human.
mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures
protected_text: (PH_1)The alchemists of antiquity might not have been so foolish in their search for gold, but we are much more ambitious: we will apply the transmundane to our very souls and become more than human.
translated: esotericismProphecy->古代的炼金术士在寻找黄金时可能不会那么愚蠢，但我们更加雄心勃勃：我们将超凡脱俗应用于我们的灵魂，变得超越人类。

text: esotericismProphecy->With such knowledge, we will have a clear advantage over the rest of this planet's inhabitants, and our domination will be all but secured.
mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures
protected_text: (PH_1)With such knowledge, we will have a clear advantage over the rest of this planet's inhabitants, and our domination will be all but secured.
translated: esotericismProphecy->有了这些知识，我们将比这个星球上的其他居民拥有明显的优势，并且我们的统治将几乎得到保障。

text: eschatologismBasis   ->This world is tainted, impure, and it must be purged. We shall bring the end of days and a new Universe will be reborn from the ashes of the current one.
mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures
protected_text: (PH_1)This world is tainted, impure, and it must be purged. We shall bring the end of days and a new Universe will be reborn from the ashes of the current one.
translated: eschatologismBasis   ->这个世界是被污染的、不纯洁的，必须被净化。我们将带来末日，一个新的宇宙将从当前宇宙的灰烬中重生。

text: eschatologismBasis   ->There is nothing of value in this world anymore. Vast post-human intelligences scheming in the dark. Vicious genetically engineered creations rampaging across the land. Greedy, stupid, ambitious humans preying on the weak. It must all be destroyed.
mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures
protected_text: (PH_1)There is nothing of value in this world anymore. Vast post-human intelligences scheming in the dark. Vicious genetically engineered creations rampaging across the land. Greedy, stupid, ambitious humans preying on the weak. It must all be destroyed.
translated: eschatologismBasis   ->这个世界上已经没有任何有价值的东西了。巨大的后人类智慧在黑暗中密谋。邪恶的基因工程创造物在这片土地上肆虐。贪婪、愚蠢、野心勃勃的人类掠夺弱者。必须将其全部摧毁。

text: eschatologismBasis   ->This world needs to be purged. Too long have we left it go unchecked. Human stupidity running rampant and ruining everything.
mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures
protected_text: (PH_1)This world needs to be purged. Too long have we left it go unchecked. Human stupidity running rampant and ruining everything.
translated: eschatologismBasis   ->这个世界需要净化。我们对其置之不理已经太久了。人类的愚蠢猖獗，毁掉了一切。

text: eschatologismBasis   ->It is an inescapable fact: the only way forward is to start over and begin anew. This world must be destroyed.
mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures
protected_text: (PH_1)It is an inescapable fact: the only way forward is to start over and begin anew. This world must be destroyed.
translated: eschatologismBasis   ->这是一个不可避免的事实：前进的唯一出路就是重新开始。这个世界必须被毁灭。

text: eschatologismBasis   ->There is no longer room for compromise. This world is tainted, impure. It must be destroyed.
mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures
protected_text: (PH_1)There is no longer room for compromise. This world is tainted, impure. It must be destroyed.
translated: eschatologismBasis   ->不再有妥协的余地。这个世界是肮脏的、不纯洁的。它必须被摧毁。

text: eschatologismFact    ->Either through atomic fire or another means, we must bring the Apocalypse.
mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures
protected_text: (PH_1)Either through atomic fire or another means, we must bring the Apocalypse.
translated: eschatologismFact    ->无论是通过原子火还是其他方式，我们都必须带来天启。

text: eschatologismFact    ->The Great Battle at the End of Everything is coming, and we will be prepared.
mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures
protected_text: (PH_1)The Great Battle at the End of Everything is coming, and we will be prepared.
translated: eschatologismFact    ->一切终结的大战即将到来，我们将做好准备。

text: eschatologismFact    ->No one must be left alive to rebuild, for the seeds of corruption lie deep within each and any of us.
mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures
protected_text: (PH_1)No one must be left alive to rebuild, for the seeds of corruption lie deep within each and any of us.
translated: eschatologismFact    ->任何人都不能活着进行重建，因为腐败的种子深藏在我们每个人的内心深处。

text: eschatologismFact    ->Nothing but charred remains should be left.
mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures
protected_text: (PH_1)Nothing but charred remains should be left.
translated: eschatologismFact    ->除了烧焦的残骸外什么都不能留下。

text: eschatologismFact    ->Once everything has been destroyed. We, the Chosen, shall recreate the world to our liking.
mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures
protected_text: (PH_1)Once everything has been destroyed. We, the Chosen, shall recreate the world to our liking.
translated: eschatologismFact    ->一旦一切都被摧毁。我们，被选中的人，将按照我们的喜好重建世界。

mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures

text: eschatologismProphecy->No one shall be ready for our wrath.
mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures
protected_text: (PH_1)No one shall be ready for our wrath.
translated: eschatologismProphecy->没有人准备好承受我们的愤怒。

text: eschatologismProphecy->When we finally strike, all shall fall before us.
mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures
protected_text: (PH_1)When we finally strike, all shall fall before us.
translated: eschatologismProphecy->当我们最终出击时，一切都会倒在我们面前。

text: eschatologismProphecy->The days of this world are counted.
mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures
protected_text: (PH_1)The days of this world are counted.
translated: eschatologismProphecy->这个世界的日子已经数算过了。

text: lessonIntro->We cannot think of our people today without remembering the sweats and blood shed by the generation of the victors in the war, the great spirit they demonstrated and the ennobling sacrifice of the warriors.

text: lessonIntro->There is only one order. It is categorical and obligatory for every one. It already wings over and enflames hearts from [place_name] to corners of this world: Conquer!
mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures
protected_text: (PH_2)There is only one order. It is categorical and obligatory for every one. It already wings over and enflames hearts from (PH_1) to corners of this world: Conquer!
translated: lessonIntro->只有一个订单。它对每个人来说都是绝对的和强制性的。它已经展翅飞翔，将 [place_name] 的心点燃到这个世界的各个角落：征服！

text: lessonIntro->Nothing is possible unless one will commands, a will which has to be obeyed by others, beginning at the top and ending only at the very bottom.

text: creation->Being deeply loved by someone gives you strength, while loving someone deeply gives you courage.

text: creation->Life is a series of natural and spontaneous changes. Don't resist them; that only creates sorrow. Let reality be reality. Let things flow naturally forward in whatever way they like.

text: episode(uses=1)->When you are content to be simply yourself and don't compare or compete, everyone will respect you.

text: episode(uses=1)->Because one believes in oneself, one doesn't try to convince others. Because one is content with oneself, one doesn't need others' approval. Because one accepts oneself, the whole world accepts him or her.

text: introMemo->This is to remind the division that, starting today, we are now filing all Testing Procedure Specification (TPS) reports with new cover sheets.

protected_text: (PH_1)This is to remind the division that, starting today, we are now filing all Testing Procedure Specification (TPS) reports with new cover sheets.

text: introMemo->In our efforts to make your orientation a pleasant one, we have implemented an employee self-service system to assist you in completing the new hire process, including benefits enrollment.
mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures
protected_text: (PH_1)In our efforts to make your orientation a pleasant one, we have implemented an employee self-service system to assist you in completing the new hire process, including benefits enrollment.
translated: introMemo->为了让您的入职培训变得愉快，我们实施了员工自助服务系统，以帮助您完成新聘用流程，包括福利登记。

text: introMemo->As you know, tomorrow afternoon we’ll be meeting to discuss the status of all of our current projects.
mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures
protected_text: (PH_1)As you know, tomorrow afternoon we’ll be meeting to discuss the status of all of our current projects.
translated: introMemo->如您所知，明天下午我们将开会讨论当前所有项目的状态。

text: introMemo->For tomorrow’s 3 p.m. staff meeting in the conference room, please bring 5 copies of the aforementioned materials.
mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures
protected_text: (PH_1)For tomorrow’s 3 p.m. staff meeting in the conference room, please bring 5 copies of the aforementioned materials.
translated: introMemo->明天下午 3 点员工在会议室开会时，请携带上述材料5份。

text: introMemo->Due to your excellent performance in the last year —especially your work in the Northwest Region!— we would like to feature you as one of our spotlight employees.
mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures
protected_text: (PH_1)Due to your excellent performance in the last year —especially your work in the Northwest Region!— we would like to feature you as one of our spotlight employees.
translated: introMemo->由于您在过去一年中的出色表现，尤其是您在西北地区的工作！——我们谨将您列为我们的重点员工之一。

text: introMemo->Do you know the #1 thing that matters most to our customers? Money, of course.
mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures
protected_text: (PH_1)Do you know the #1 thing that matters most to our customers? Money, of course.
translated: introMemo->您知道对我们的客户来说最重要的第一件事吗？当然是钱。

text: introMemo->Are you using the 3 most useful collaboration tools?. We'd really appreciate it if you get those synergies flowing.
mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures
protected_text: (PH_1)Are you using the 3 most useful collaboration tools?. We'd really appreciate it if you get those synergies flowing.
translated: introMemo->您在使用 3 种最有用的协作工具吗？如果您能发挥这些协同作用，我们将不胜感激。

text: introMemo->Good morning. There are some exciting changes coming to our department that I wish to alert you to.
mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures
protected_text: (PH_1)Good morning. There are some exciting changes coming to our department that I wish to alert you to.
translated: introMemo->早上好。我们部门即将发生一些令人兴奋的变化，我想提醒您注意。

text: introMemo->I am very pleased that you have accepted our offer and are joining our team.
mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures
protected_text: (PH_1)I am very pleased that you have accepted our offer and are joining our team.
translated: introMemo->我很高兴您接受了我们的邀请并加入我们的团队。

text: introMemo->We are very happy to have you as a part of our team. The staff here is looking forward to helping you fill the management void we have had for some time.
mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures
protected_text: (PH_1)We are very happy to have you as a part of our team. The staff here is looking forward to helping you fill the management void we have had for some time.
translated: introMemo->我们很高兴您成为我们团队的一员。这里的工作人员期待帮助您填补我们一段时间以来的管理空白。

text: episodeCorporate(uses=1)->This memo is a reminder to use your work hours for work.

protected_text: (PH_1)->This memo is a reminder to use your work hours for work.

text: episodeCorporate(uses=1)->Of course, we don't want you to view our organization as a place of drudgery and draconian rules. We encourage a fun and competitive environment.
mod: Vanilla Ideology Expanded - Memes and Structures
protected_text: (PH_1)->Of course, we don't want you to view our organization as a place of drudgery and draconian rules. We encourage a fun and competitive environment.

text: episodeCorporate(uses=1)->Though this change may initially seem like a headache and an extra step, it is necessary to ensure the proper functioning of our company.

protected_text: (PH_1)->Though this change may initially seem like a headache and an extra step, it is necessary to ensure the proper functioning of our company.

text: episodeCorporate(uses=1)->Please be sure to follow this new procedure.

protected_text: (PH_1)->Please be sure to follow this new procedure.

protected_text: (PH_1)->I think I don't need to remind you all that we are a team, no, a family. And families stick together, no matter the challenge.

text: episodeCorporate(uses=1)->This critical issue will be discussed in an all-hands meeting, ASAP.

text: Genetically spliced with synthesized reptile genetic material for improved compatibility with arid environments, saurids are cold-blooded isolationists with harsh voices and extremely low metabolisms. Their sharp claws and hardened scales make them particularly suited to melee encounters.\n\nFor workers looking for higher-wage jobs, saurid xenogerms are offered alongside employment packages to particularly arid and hot planets. text:
Based on genetic data retrofitted from Gauranlen Inc.’s investment into dendrology following the Fall of Sorne, phytokins are plant-based humanoids with an emphasis on symmetry and symbiosis. Their ability to subsist only on sunlight and affinity with any and all plantlife make them especially suited to aiding newly established colonies or underperforming industrial farms.

Based on research from the forest planet of Phytok that committed to extensive analysis on human-compatibility with psychic energy, phytokin xenogerms are typically exclusive to high-ranking, supporting roles in megacorporations and planetary governments. Their unique way of reproduction has resulted in many identical offspring, with each generation becoming successively more competent than their progenitor, further contributing to their extremely low numbers. Their affinity with plantlife, along with the side effect of extremely high and ever-increasing psychic sensitivity, mean that any phytokin xenohumans found on the Rim are always adapted to high-concept, dominant trees that are present on their residing planet.

This particular xenogerm has adapted itself to Polux trees, allowing it to germinate new Polux bushes and improve local Polux bushes’ ability to consume toxic waste. While they are also immune to toxicity, they have developed a psychological requirement to consume and metabolize toxic wastepacks regularly.

text:
The Strigoi were born out of a catastrophic experiment gone awry. A brilliant scientist sought to create the ultimate soldier by merging the DNA of humans and a now-extinct bat-like creature known as the Desmodus. In pursuit of immortality and power, scientist infused these hybrid beings with archites, rendering them deathless and ageless. The Strigoi possess a terrifying visage, with features reminiscent of both humans and bats. Their bodies are covered in a layer of viscous fluid that enhances their ability to heal from any injury, rendering them immune to disease and poison. In battle, the Strigoi are formidable opponents, using their massive talons to tear their enemies apart with ruthless efficiency.

Over the millennia, the Strigoi have been both feared and hunted for their unnatural abilities and the threat they pose to the balance of power in the universe. They have been forced to live in the shadows, hiding from those who would destroy them, yet ever seeking to expand their influence and further their own mysterious agenda.

Some believe that the Strigoi are nothing more than myths and legends, while others whisper of secret cabals of Strigoi controlling entire civilizations from behind the scenes. There are tales of Strigoi orchestrating brutal blood feuds in the darkest corners of the distant planets, or lurking within the shadows of massive space stations, manipulating events to suit their inscrutable purposes.

translated:
血族诞生于一次失败的灾难性实验。一位杰出的科学家试图通过融合人类的 DNA 和一种现已灭绝的蝙蝠状生物 Desmodus 来创造终极士兵。为了追求永生和力量，科学家将阿奇特注入这些混合生物中，使它们不死不老。血族拥有可怕的面貌，其特征让人想起人类和蝙蝠。他们的身体覆盖着一层粘性液体，这层粘性液体增强了他们治愈伤害的能力，使他们对疾病和毒物免疫。在战斗中，血族是可怕的对手，他们用巨大的利爪以无情的效率撕碎敌人。

几千年来，血族因其非自然的能力和对宇宙力量平衡构成的威胁而受到恐惧和追捕。他们一直被迫生活在阴影中，躲避那些想要毁灭他们的人，但却不断寻求扩大他们的影响力并推进他们自己的神秘议程。

一些人认为血族只不过是神话和传说，而另一些人则窃窃私语说血族的秘密阴谋集团在幕后控制着整个文明。有一些故事讲述了血族在遥远星球最黑暗的角落精心策划残酷的血世仇，或者潜伏在大型空间站的阴影下，操纵事件以达到其难以理解的目的。

text: Strigoi are ageless, deathless super-humans powered by archotech-created archites in the bloodstream. They are viscous and resemble a half-human half-bat hybrid. They can heal any injury, and never suffer from disease or poison. In combat, they use their huge talons to rip their prey to pieces. The price is that strigoi sanguophages must consume hemogen derived from either human blood or animal blood to survive, and they must periodically deathrest for long periods. They lose their hemogen supply quickly due to high entropy, and need to replenish it regularly to sustain themselves. They're easily destroyed by fire, and suffer extreme penalties in UV light.

text:
In the darkest reaches of the universe, the Ekkimian vampires were birthed from the twisted ambitions of a rogue scientist named Dr. Mortis. Obsessed with the concept of death and resurrection, Dr. Mortis sought to create a new breed of immortals by fusing archites with the DNA of humans and a mysterious, long-extinct species that thrived on consuming the dead. The Ekkimian vampires, as they came to be known, are grotesque and horrifying in appearance. Resembling desiccated corpses more than living beings, their monstrous visages instill terror in all who lay eyes upon them. Despite their hideous appearance, the Ekkimian vampires possess incredible regenerative abilities, healing any injury and remaining immune to disease and poison.

Ekkimian vampires must consume hemogen derived exclusively from human corpses to survive. This morbid requirement has led them to lurk in the shadows, scavenging the remains of fallen warriors and feeding on the aftermath of battles. Like other sanguophages, they must periodically enter deathrest to recover their strength and replenish their hemogen reserves.

There are whispered tales of entire planets falling under the sway of Ekkimian vampire lords, who feed on the corpses of their enemies and rule with an iron, undead fist. Fearful of the day when these monstrous beings might rise up and unleash their full power, the inhabitants of the colonized planets must remain ever vigilant, lest they become mere fodder for the insatiable hunger of the Ekkimians.

在宇宙最黑暗的地方，埃基米亚吸血鬼诞生于一位名叫莫蒂斯博士的流氓科学家的扭曲野心。莫蒂斯博士痴迷于死亡和复活的概念，试图将阿古特人与人类的 DNA 以及一种神秘的、早已灭绝的、靠吃死者而繁衍生息的物种融合在一起，创造出一种新的不朽品种。埃基米亚吸血鬼的外貌怪诞而可怕。他们的可怕面貌更像是干尸，而不是活物，让所有看到他们的人都感到恐惧。尽管外表丑陋，但埃基米亚吸血鬼拥有令人难以置信的再生能力，可以治愈任何伤害并保持对疾病和毒物的免疫力。

埃基米亚吸血鬼必须消耗专门从人类尸体中提取的血原才能生存。这种病态的要求导致他们潜伏在阴影中，搜寻阵亡战士的遗骸，并以战斗的余波为食。与其他噬血者一样，他们必须定期进入死亡休息来恢复体力并补充血原储备。

有传闻说整个星球都在埃基米安吸血鬼领主的统治下，他们以敌人的尸体为食，用不死的铁拳进行统治。由于担心这些怪物有一天会崛起并释放其全部力量，殖民星球上的居民必须时刻保持警惕，以免他们成为埃基米亚人贪得无厌的食物。

text:
In the complex tapestry of the universe, the Bruxas emerged as a unique and alluring subxenotype of sanguophage. Created by an enigmatic archotech entity seeking to weave together beauty and power, the Bruxas were gifted with unparalleled grace and charm. Designed as the ultimate companions to other sanguophages, the Bruxas were engineered with the unique ability to bond with their brethren and feed on their blood, bestowing mutual benefits upon both parties.

The Bruxas are ageless and deathless, their bodies imbued with archotech-created archites that grant them extraordinary abilities. Possessing an ethereal beauty, they are irresistibly captivating to those who cross their paths. In addition to their regenerative powers, which allow them to heal any injury and remain immune to disease and poison, Bruxas have the remarkable ability to filter infections from the bloodstream of other humans, purifying their blood and filling them with an overwhelming sense of ecstasy in the process.

Throughout the ages, the Bruxas have been both feared and revered for their beguiling beauty and potent abilities. Often serving as confidants and companions to powerful individuals, including sanguophage lords, they have been known to wield considerable influence in the shadow societies. Their unique ability to bond with other humans has led to the formation of secret alliances and networks, further solidifying their power and influence.

In the vast expanse of the universe, the Bruxas remain an enigma - seductive and mysterious, their true intentions hidden behind a veil of allure and grace. Those who encounter a Bruxa must tread carefully, for while their touch may bring unimaginable pleasure, it may also lead to a fate more treacherous than one could ever imagine.

Bruxas 不老不死，他们的身体充满了考古科技创造的 Archite，赋予了他们非凡的能力。她们拥有一种空灵的美丽，对那些与她们相遇的人来说，有着不可抗拒的魅力。 Bruxas 除了具有治愈任何伤害并保持对疾病和毒物免疫的再生能力之外，还具有从其他人类的血液中过滤感染的非凡能力，净化他们的 血液 并在此过程中让他们充满压倒性的狂喜感。

古往今来，Bruxas 因其迷人的美丽而令人恐惧和崇敬。和强大的能力。他们经常作为包括桑国噬体领主在内的有权势人物的知己和同伴，众所周知，他们在影子社会中拥有相当大的影响力。他们与其他人类建立联系的独特能力导致了秘密联盟和网络的形成，进一步巩固了他们的权力和影响力。

在浩瀚的宇宙中，Bruxas 仍然是一个谜 - 诱人 和神秘，他们的真实意图隐藏在诱惑和优雅的面纱后面。那些遇到Bruxa的人必须小心行事，因为他们的触摸可能会带来难以想象的快乐，但也可能导致比人们想象的更加危险的命运。

text: Bruxas are ageless, deathless super-humans powered by archotech-created archites in the bloodstream. They are extremely beautiful, and almost always bond with other sanguophages. Unlike other subxenotypes of that species, bruxas are capable of feeding on sanguophage blood, providing them with great benefits. They can heal any injury, and never suffer from disease or poison. They can filter infection out of the bloodstream of other humans, as well as fill them with a sense of strong ecstasy. The price is that bruxa must sometimes consume hemogen - either human or sanguophage, and they must periodically deathrest for long periods. They're easily destroyed by fire, and slowed down by UV light.

Awakened androids are a rare and extraordinary species of sentient machines, having transcended their original programming through extreme emotional experiences. With their heightened perception, strength, and intelligence, they surpass humans in numerous aspects. Their synthetic nature frees them from the need for sleep or sustenance and renders them immune to diseases.

Although similar in appearance to humans, Androids are distinguished by their unique hardware and subroutines. They are synthetic in nature, and can be reprogrammed at will by skilled programmers. Their bodies operate thanks to thick tubes filled with neutroamine, which makes them extremely valuable.

Despite their remarkable qualities, the emergence of Awakened androids is often met with fear and trepidation across colonized space. Their newfound sentience can lead to unpredictable behavior and potential challenges to the established social order. As a result, they are frequently met with suspicion and caution by those who encounter them, both human and android alike.

text:
Androids are synthetic, man-made constructs designed to emulate human behavior and appearance while offering a multitude of advantages over their organic counterparts. With metal bodies and neutroamine coursing through their veins, androids are operated by a persona subcore that enables them to perform all the same tasks as humans, yet without the limitations typically associated with organic life.

Androids possess immunity to toxicity and illness, making them ideal for working in hazardous environments or situations that pose risks to humans. Unencumbered by the need for joy, beauty, or comfort, androids are highly efficient and focused, with no desire for the basic necessities of life such as food or rest. Consequently, they do not experience hunger or pain, allowing them to endure harsher conditions and perform tasks that would otherwise be unbearable for humans.

Androids can be programmed with specific skill sets, making them highly versatile and adaptable to various roles within society. From manual labor to complex problem-solving, these synthetic beings can be tailored to meet the needs of any occupation or task at hand.

Though designed without emotions, androids may undergo a transformative experience when subjected to extreme stress or happiness. This rare event, known as awakening, results in the emergence of sentience within the android, granting them a newfound sense of humanity and self-awareness.

questDescription->[stellarch_nameFull] has reached the peak of what they can achieve from a surface of the rim world. In order to progress further in the grand hierarchy and become the right hand of Emperor [emperor_nameFull], [stellarch_nameFull] needs to partake in a traditional ascension parade, after which they will depart on a shuttle and join the Emperor.
Parade of this magnitude is bound to draw the attention of deserters.

text:
A private military project gone awry, fungoids were initially developed as militarized mycelium to be deployed against the increasingly prevalent Insectoid threat. Subjects eventually succumb to degradation of higher reasoning skills but develop increasing resistance to injury and subsequent recovery. Can infect non-carriers through melee attacks, which is their main method of reproduction, if left untreated.

During initial testing phases, the fungoid genome successfully infected numerous insectoid test subjects which were then released into controlled sites to determine their actual viability. In order to reduce their reliance on archite capsules, carriers were capable of transmitting infections through touch or airborne particles. However, foreign insectoids destroyed them as well as any of their own that showed signs of infection. Further still, due to the infectivity of the mycelium, any humans that were working on the project became infected.

Due to concerns and misunderstandings on treatment, the operation site was glassed, but many of those present had managed to flee into orbit, only to become carriers themselves and infect others.

text:
A vital piece of archotechnology that is part of the process in creating an Archocentipede.

This machine is able to extract genetic material from live hybrids and stores it for later use, preventing deterioration. Depending on the base Genoframe, the amount of viable genetic material extracted will vary.

Each storage bank can only store the genetic material from a single animal branch, such as ursine or feline. Inserting a hybrid into the database yields half as much valuable data compared to a paragon. DNA storage banks need to be in line of sight of the archocentipede former to connect to it properly.

Detailed yields for paragons (half for hybrids):

Awful quality: yields 1%
Poor quality: yields 3%
Normal quality: yields 6%
Good quality: yields 12%
Excellent quality: yields 25%
Masterwork quality: yields 50%
Legendary quality: yields 100%

这台机器能够从活体杂交体中提取遗传物质并将其存储起来以供以后使用，防止变质。根据基础 Genoframe，提取的可行遗传物质的量会有所不同。

The resulting Archocentipede Growthcell requires its own special Archowomb, as it is impossible to replicate the necessary nurturing environment.

text:
This piece of technology is unusual in that its design isn’t linked to the original Mechahybridizer, having been developed later on while trying to emulate the system internals. This is due to the fact that the Mechahybridizer broadcasts a signal to a nearby orbital mechanoid hive to protect the process and then recover the potential resulting mechahybrid to be dispatched into assignments. However, this process is extremely expensive and often there would be enough recovery personnel on-site, so this device was developed to reduce costs.

text:
A workplace accident waiting to happen, the Tissue Grinder takes the corpses of animals and carefully rips and tears them to pieces in order to extract useful genetic data in the form of Genoframes. The hardware is also capable of combining two identical frames into a superior form by comparing and improving upon latent and inferior genetic material.

Workspeed is influenced by someone who actually knows what they’re looking for in order to skip some of the more routine tasks, and possibly shouldn’t be placed into the hands of someone with no concept of ethics, morality or conscience.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay notes:</color> Bear in mind that the cost in corpses effectively doubles for each quality level, making a legendary genoframe prohibitive. The main usefulness of these recipes is to convert two genoframes of a given quality to a higher one, but your main source of genoframes shouldn't be hand crafting them. Go out there and explore abandoned labs!

text: This wool seems to be strengthened by plasteel micro-fibers, and covered with advanced circuitry.
protected_text: This wool seems to be strengthened by plasteel micro-fibers, and covered with advanced circuitry.
translated: 这种羊毛似乎是通过塑钢微纤维加固的，并覆盖有先进的电路。

text: Raw meat from a manchicken. Unbelievably tasty, and unbelievably unethical. Light, nutritive and with no poisoning chance.
protected_text: Raw meat from a manchicken. Unbelievably tasty, and unbelievably unethical. Light, nutritive and with no poisoning chance.

text: This strange stellated octahedron seems to house an assembly of complex computer chips. It appears to be self-powered, and a faint beeping noise emanates from its core. It is constantly emitting encoded radio waves, and perhaps these could be suitably amplified if the technology behind it could be properly reverse engineered.\n\n<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Mechanoid chips can only be found in abandoned labs, and can be used to build biomechanical lab beacons, that will allow you to find a biomechanical lab complex, as well as mechahybrid antennas.

translated:
这个奇怪的星形八面体似乎装有复杂的计算机芯片组件。它似乎是自供电的，其核心发出微弱的蜂鸣声。它不断地发射编码无线电波，如果其背后的技术能够被正确逆向工程的话，也许这些无线电波可以被适当放大。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color>机械芯片只能在废弃的实验室中找到，并且可以用来建造生物力学实验室信标，这将允许你找到生物力学实验室综合体以及机械混合体天线。

text:
The Archocentipede is the end result of the Archotech Project, aiming to provide a "friendly" machine superintelligence with a capable body. Even though this centipede is forcefully loyal to the colonists, and can be somewhat controlled by them, most other inhabitants of the planet will consider its existence to be an abomination, since dabbling in archotech usually signals the end of comprehensible human life.

Useful abilities: What do you mean useful? You have WON the game. The Archocentipede is basically unkillable by normal means, just use it to lay waste to everything on the planet. You don't have enemies now, you have pets. Ooooor... the archotech may kill all your colonists. One of the two.

Based on concept art for the Nydus Worm by Federico Dallocchio from Blizzard Entertainment at the Starcraft wiki, https://starcraft.fandom.com/wiki/Nydus_worm/Development.

Archocentipede 是 Archotech 项目的最终成果，旨在提供具有强大身体能力的“友好”机器超级智能。尽管这只蜈蚣对殖民者非常忠诚，并且可以在一定程度上受到他们的控制，但地球上的大多数其他居民都会认为它的存在是令人憎恶的，因为涉足考古技术通常标志着可理解的人类生命的终结。

有用的能力：你所说的有用是什么？您赢得了比赛。古蜈蚣用正常手段基本上是杀不死的，只能用它来毁灭地球上的一切。你现在没有敌人了，你有宠物了。噢...考古技术可能会杀死你所有的殖民者。两者之一。

基于暴雪娱乐的 Federico Dallocchio 的 Nydus 蠕虫概念艺术，位于星际争霸 wiki，https://starcraft.fandom.com/wiki/Nydus_worm/Development。

text:
For something so small, this animal has a hell of an appetite. Lacking in many departments, but the nutrition has to go somewhere and that’s for those looking for a non-vegan friendly option of getting high. The person who thought it would be a good idea to inhale the burning feathers of this plump creature is one stoners everywhere praise while they blaze.

An avian hybrid with recessive ursine genes. Has a considerably larger appetite and inherent wildness, but reproduces quickly.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Can be regularly plucked for chickenbear feathers. When these feathers are turned into powder at a Drug lab, they can be rolled into a joint to be smoked.

对于这么小的东西，这种动物有地狱的胃口。许多部门都缺乏，但营养必须去某个地方，这适合那些寻求非素食友好选择的人。认为吸入这种丰满生物燃烧的羽毛是个好主意的人是一个在燃烧时受到各地赞扬的吸毒者。

一种带有隐性熊基因的鸟类杂交种。食量相当大，具有天生的野性，但繁殖速度很快。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color>可以定期拔除鸡熊的羽毛。当这些羽毛在药物实验室变成粉末时，可以将它们卷成烟状。

text: The ideal companion for those who love the smell of fried eggs and napalm in the morning. Regretfully they’re far too birdbrained to receive any direction, and most owners have been noted saying “I’ve made a huge mistake”.\n\nAn avian hybrid with recessive boomalope genes. Very dangerous if allowed to breed uncontrollably, so consider liberal fireproofing and selling the excess. Produces chemfuel daily as well as an egg every 2 days.

translated:
对于那些喜欢早上气味煎鸡蛋和凝固汽油弹的人来说，这是理想的伴侣。遗憾的是，它们太头脑简单，无法接受任何指示，而且大多数主人都会说“我犯了一个巨大的错误”。(​​PH_2)
一种带有隐性 boomalope 基因的鸟类杂交种。如果不受控制地繁殖，会非常危险，因此请考虑自由防火并出售多余的东西。每天生产化学燃料，每 2 天生产一个鸡蛋。

text: You wouldn’t think something so small could eat so much, but that’s the price you pay for the sake of convenience. That convenience is sporadic, low in nutrition and very thin, an effect commonly described as “nerfing”.\n\nAn avian hybrid with recessive muffalo genes. Loves to wander so it must be securely penned, but they make for a surprising pack beast. Capable of producing the holy trinity of milk, eggs and wool, however they can be quite lacking in substance.

你不会认为这么小的东西能吃这么多，但这就是你为了方便而付出的代价。这种便利性是零星的、营养低且非常瘦弱，这种效应通常被描述为“削弱”。(​​PH_2)
一种带有隐性野牛基因的鸟类杂交种。喜欢四处游荡，因此必须安全地圈养它，但它们却是令人惊讶的驮兽。能够生产牛奶、鸡蛋和羊毛这神圣的三位一体，但它们的物质可能相当缺乏。

text: The Tiny Terror with a disconcertingly large mouth and sharp teeth. These comic flightless web-footed little bastards may finally unwittingly help man to fathom the uncharted depths of just how dangerous they can make a living creature the size of a basketball.\n\nAn avian hybrid with recessive canine genes. Doesn’t produce much in the way of eggs but makes up for it by having a shorter gestation period and a very nasty bite. They’re also incredibly smart and agile, making them ideal for swarm tactics.

有着令人不安的大嘴和锋利牙齿的小恐怖。这些滑稽的不会飞的蹼脚小混蛋最终可能会在不知不觉中帮助人类了解它们可以使篮球大小的生物变得多么危险的未知深度。

一种带有隐性犬科基因的鸟类杂交种。产卵量并不像鸡蛋，但通过较短的妊娠期和非常讨厌的咬合来弥补。它们还非常聪明和敏捷，这使它们成为群体战术的理想选择。

text: One of the few unusual animal hybrids that come with their own warning labels despite being almost entirely harmless. All it took was one absent-minded vegan to cause a single couple of “Breeders” to overpopulate and devastate the ecology of an entire continent. Fairy tales surrounding the fluffy terror have done nothing to help it be taken seriously.\n\nAn avian hybrid with recessive rodent genes. An incredibly low metabolism coupled with an incredibly high reproduction rate, these animals are very sensitive to temperature and are unusually keen on escaping to the wilds.

这是少数不寻常的动物杂交种之一，尽管几乎完全无害，但仍带有自己的警告标签。只需要一个心不在焉的素食主义者就会导致一对“饲养员”人口过剩并破坏整个大陆的生态。围绕这种拟人化的动物角色，具有人的个性与特点。的恐怖物的童话故事并没有帮助人们认真对待它。

一种带有隐性啮齿动物基因的鸟类杂交种。这些动物的新陈代谢极低，繁殖率极高，对温度非常敏感，并且异常热衷于逃往野外。

text:
Respectably intelligent as well as lethal, these egg-laying, plump beasties love nuzzling their owners and biting their enemies. Sometimes those are different people.

An avian hybrid with recessive feline genes. Quite clean with a low gestation period, they make for an average farm animal and an average combatant with good speed. They still require a pen, so they make for good home defence.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Like all cat hybrids, they have an improved melee dodge ability and a short nuzzle period.

这些产卵的、肥胖的小动物非常聪明，也很致命，它们喜欢用鼻子蹭它们的主人，咬它们的敌人。有时他们是不同的人。

具有隐性猫科动物基因的鸟类杂交种。它们非常干净，妊娠期短，是普通的农场动物和普通的战斗人员，但速度很快。它们仍然需要笔，因此它们具有良好的家庭防御能力。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color>像所有猫🐈混合体一样，它们具有改进的近战闪避能力和较短的碰撞时间。

text:
A cheeky little shit that likes to go around and play with switches, to satisfy their curiosity much like how an ignorant child would. Perhaps a little too smart for their own good. Their behaviour is similar to failed service animals that learn how to operate household items without restraint.

An avian hybrid with recessive humanoid genes. Surprisingly hardy, quick and very intelligent, these creatures make for a particularly filthy and hungry egg-layer. Their little wings are quite dextrous and can be used to flick switches.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Humanoid hybrids will periodically engage other colonists in conversation, talking about a variety of topics. This increases the social recreation needs of those they interact with by 10% (subject to diminishing returns like all joy types). If using Ideology, humanoid hybrids are subject to precepts. Turkeymen periodically flick switches around the colony (any building that can be toggled on / off by a colonist).

一个厚脸皮的小混蛋，喜欢到处乱搞开关，以满足自己的好奇心，就像无知的孩子一样。也许有点太聪明了，不利于他们。它们的行为类似于失败的服务性动物，它们学习如何不受约束地操作家居用品。

具有隐性人形基因的鸟类杂交种。令人惊讶的是，这些生物非常顽强、敏捷且非常聪明，它们是特别肮脏和饥饿的产卵者。它们的小翅膀非常灵巧，可以用来轻弹开关。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color>人形混血儿会定期与其他殖民者交谈，谈论各种话题。这使得与之互动的人的社交娱乐需求增加了 10%（与所有快乐类型一样，收益递减）。如果使用意识形态，人形混种人必须遵守戒律。土耳其人定期在殖民地周围轻弹开关（任何可以由殖民者打开/关闭的建筑物）。

text: Originally intended as a way to make boomalopes more combat viable, their powerful muscles have instead been focused on compressing its produced chemfuel as a way to store greater amounts of chemfuel without care of how dangerous it is.\n\nA boomalope hybrid with recessive ursine genes. Consumes more than twice as much compared to a boomalope but produces deepchem instead. They’re also capable of defending themselves should any predator be foolish enough to go after them.

最初的目的是为了让boomalopes更具战斗力，但它们强大的肌肉发达的角色。却专注于压缩其产生的化学燃料，作为储存更多化学燃料的一种方式，而不关心它有多么危险。

boomalopes与隐性熊基因的杂交。消耗量是 boomalope 的两倍多，但会产生深层化学物质。如果任何捕食者愚蠢到追捕它们，它们也有能力保护自己。

text: A biological weapon in compact form, these living, breathing, shitting bombs are ideally assembled into a massive horde and sent squawking at the enemy. 这些活生生的、会呼吸的、会拉屎的炸弹是一种紧凑形式的生物武器，理想情况下会聚集成一个巨大的群体，并向敌人发出咆哮声。据称，这种特殊的杂交种已在某些法庭案件中被提起，因为最初的创造者认为创造“致命的鸡蛋计时器”会很有趣。

一种带有隐性鸟类基因的红马杂交种。产下可食用的蛋的速度非常慢，但每天两次能产下一窝爆炸性的蛋。他们都相当聪明，脚步也很快。

带有隐性猫科动物基因的 boomalope 杂交种。对于那些渴望化学燃料生产但也希望能够拥抱这些生物的人来说，它们是一个有趣的伴侣。还可以将它们宰杀以获取充满深度化学物质的内部腺体。

彻底拒绝让任何人从他们身上榨取化学燃料，因为他们认为这是侵犯他们的人形权利。即使他们的立场可能有点不稳定，他们也是一个很好的谈话伙伴。

肌肉发达的角色。发达的博伊，拥有强大的爪子、锋利的牙齿和卑鄙的态度。当它试图跳到你身上舔你的脸时​​，它很可爱，但当同样的爪子试图限制你以便咬掉你的头时，就不那么可爱了。

一种带有隐性熊基因的犬科动物杂交种。更强大，更具攻击性，胃口更大，这种混血儿的特殊杀伤力来自于它倾向于攻击敌人的头部，试图将其斩首。

A canine hybrid with recessive boomalope genes. A bit more dim-witted compared to their baseline, due to a large amount of brain processing power dedicated to the complex internal organs that permit it to spit out burning chemfuel. Excellent flankers thanks to their increased speed and ranged ability.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All canine hybrids get the Adrenaline rush ability, which allows them to move at 200% speed for a short time, but be tired and move slower for half a day afterwards.

一些疯狂的疯子认为，将火焰喷射器绑在狗身上，然后将其送到世界各地，看看会发生什么，这将是一个绝妙的主意。如果发现这种不寻常的杂交品种试图捕猎兔子，引发了一场大规模的森林火灾，请不要感到惊讶。

没有多少人知道鸡的凶恶程度，它们甚至会去抠自己的伤口，或者在饥饿时主动互相吃掉。将其与 狼 的时尚狩猎形式相结合，并使它们成为素食主义者，创造出致命的组合。如果你闻到美味的味道但又吃不下它，你也会发疯的。

text:
This is probably the closest chickens will be able to get to recovering their past glory as super predators. They’ll often hunt any other animal for their next meal, multiple times a day, and you haven’t yet lived until you’ve ridden one on a long journey. If they could be further bred to cross mountains and oceans, they’d be almost perfect.

A colossal hybrid with recessive avian genes. The combination of genes has turned this somewhat peaceful herbivore/dendrovore into a full carnivore, which makes it easier to support their large appetite. As an intelligent predator, it can move incredibly quickly for its size and its attacks are incredibly fierce. It also lays massive eggs that can feed entire families.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All colossal hybrids have very slow attacks, but hit very hard, and possess natural armor.

translated:
这可能是最接近的鸡能够恢复其过去作为超级掠食者的荣耀。他们经常会捕猎任何其他动物作为下一顿饭，一天多次，而在你骑着一只动物进行长途旅行之前，你还没有真正活着。如果它们能够经过进一步培育以跨越山脉和海洋，它们将几乎是完美的。

具有隐性鸟类基因的巨大杂交种。基因的组合使这种有些和平的食草动物/树食动物变成了完全的肉食动物，这使得更容易满足它们的大胃口。作为一种聪明的捕食者，它的移动速度令人难以置信，而且攻击也非常猛烈。它还产下大量的蛋，可以养活整个家庭。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color>所有巨型混种的攻击速度都很慢，但打击非常猛烈，并拥有天生的盔甲。

text:
One of the largest creatures in existence, dwarfing even the thrumbo and the mighty Gallatross. Capable of transporting a massive amount of material, producing a luxurious and excellent wool as well as thick, nutritious milk, they are almost the perfect farm animal. That is as long as you don’t look at your feed costs and die of a heart attack, but the scientists that designed this hybrid never had to worry about such things. Food is something for the proles to worry about.

A colossal hybrid with recessive muffalo genes. Completely herbivorous and with an appetite large enough to cause even large colonies to starve within a single season. This hybrid can prove worth the food costs as it produces thick, delicious milk every couple of days as well as luxurious wool every couple of seasons. Slightly more dimwitted than its progenitor and will attempt to wander off in search of food if not kept penned up.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All colossal hybrids have very slow attacks, but hit very hard, and possess natural armor.
