translated:
现存最大的生物之一，甚至使巨响兽和强大的加拉特罗斯都相形见绌。它们能够运输大量的物质，生产出奢华优质的羊毛以及浓稠、营养丰富的牛奶，它们几乎是完美的农场动物。只要你不考虑饲料成本就会死于心脏病，但设计这种混合动力车的科学家们从来不用担心这些事情。食物是无产阶级要担心的事情。

带有隐性野牛基因的巨型杂交种。完全草食性，食欲大到足以导致大型群体在一个季节内挨饿。这种杂交品种可以证明物有所值，因为它每隔几天就会产出浓稠、美味的牛奶，每隔几个季节就会产出奢华的羊毛。比它的祖先稍微笨一些，如果不被关起来，就会试图四处游荡寻找食物。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color>所有巨型混种的攻击速度都很慢，但攻击力很强，并且拥有天生的盔甲。

text:
There’s a saying about the scientific community, namely “your scientists were so preoccupied with whether they could, they didn’t stop to think if they should”. This is entirely relevant to this creature, a super predator with practically no equal, a single one of these is enough to require an entire rainforest to support their daily sustenance. If that wasn’t bad enough, they were made along with the Thrumbocat as part of a duo.

A colossal hybrid with recessive canine genes. A large predator with an insane appetite with the necessary ferocity to support itself, very few colonies can support the diet of such a hybrid. Incredibly robust, fast and a terrifying ferocity, they will hunt multiple times a day and often go after prey much bigger than themselves.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All colossal hybrids have very slow attacks, but hit very hard, and possess natural armor.

科学界有一句话，即“你们的科学家们如此专注于他们是否可以，他们没有停止去思考他们是否应该这样做”。这与这种生物完全相关，它是一种几乎无与伦比的超级掠食者，其中的一个就足以需要整个雨林来维持它们的日常食物。如果这还不够糟糕的话，它们是与 Thrumbocat 一起作为二重奏的一部分制作的。

带有隐性犬科动物基因的巨大杂交体。作为一种大型捕食者，食欲旺盛，具有维持自身所需的凶猛性，很少有群体能够支持这种混血儿的饮食。它们极其强壮、速度快、凶猛得可怕，每天会捕猎多次，并且常常追捕比自己大得多的猎物。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color>所有巨型混种的攻击速度都很慢，但攻击力却很强，并且拥有天生的盔甲。

text:
The other half of the super predator duo, along with the Thrumwolf, exchanging some ferocity and durability in exchange for going for the trachea and spitting suffocating hairballs. That might not sound that dangerous but imagine having a fistful of hair pulled from a shower drain smothering your mouth, and you’ll realise that’s still not disgusting enough. But for those that it appreciates, it will often pin them down and snuggle them given the chance.

A colossal hybrid with recessive feline genes. A large predator with an insane appetite with a focus on ferocious attacks that restrict their prey’s breathing. Extremely agile with a soft spot for those it loves, best suited for biomes that support enough wildlife to sate its hunger.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All colossal hybrids have very slow attacks, but hit very hard, and possess natural armor.

超级掠食者二人组的另一半，以及Thrumwolf，用一些凶猛和耐用来换取气管和吐出令人有意限制对大脑的供氧，往往是为了使性觉醒。的毛团。这听起来可能没那么危险，但想象一下从淋浴排水管里拔出一把头发捂住你的嘴，你就会意识到这还不够恶心。但对于那些它欣赏的人，只要有机会，它通常会抓住它们并依偎它们。

具有隐性猫科动物基因的巨大杂交体。一种食欲旺盛的大型掠食者，专注于凶猛的攻击，限制猎物的呼吸。极其敏捷，对其所爱之人情有独钟，最适合养活足够野生动物以满足其饥饿的生物群落。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color>所有巨型混种的攻击速度都很慢，但攻击力却很强，并拥有天生的盔甲。

text:
A leftover bioweapon from a now extinct civilisation designed to completely eradicate biomes with dense vegetation. Records indicate that the local indigineous tribes were very resistant to corporate takeover and the megacorp in charge wanted to reduce profit losses. Eventually the planet starved as they were unable to stop these creatures from feasting on farmlands and food reserves.

A colossal hybrid with recessive insectoid genes. A slow moving tank with limited regenerative capabilities, they are almost unkillable if it weren’t for their crippling hunger. As durable as a capital ship, any colony that could possibly support the diet of even a single one would be considered impervious to raids.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All colossal hybrids have very slow attacks, but hit very hard, and possess natural armor. They are always sterile and can't reproduce, even if a fertility booster is used to create them.

translated:
一种现已灭绝的文明遗留下来的生物武器，旨在彻底消灭植被茂密的生物群落。记录显示，当地土著部落非常抵制企业收购，而负责的大型企业希望减少利润损失。最终，地球陷入了饥饿，因为他们无法阻止这些生物以农田和食物储备为食。

具有隐性类昆虫基因的巨大杂种。它们是移动缓慢、再生能力有限的坦克，如果不是极度饥饿，它们几乎是杀不死的。与主力舰一样耐用，任何可能支持单个个体饮食的殖民地都将被认为不受袭击。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color>所有巨型混合体的攻击速度都很慢，但打击非常猛烈，并拥有天生的装甲。它们始终是不育的并且无法繁殖，即使使用生育增强剂来创造它们也是如此。

text:
About as close as anyone has ever gotten in making a recreation of dragons from folklore. Capable of surviving in extreme cold or heat, the only thing really missing is a pair of wings and an innate desire to hoard piles of gold for a nest. That and the fact that it isn’t carnivorous, instead having an appetite for vegetables and wood fibres.

A colossal hybrid with recessive reptile genes. With a mouth dripping with venom and tough, flexible scales covering the body, this hybrid makes for a nasty and incredibly durable combat hybrid. If that wasn’t enough, it can also breath out a fog of noxious fumes and move deceptively quickly.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All colossal hybrids have very slow attacks, but hit very hard, and possess natural armor. All reptile hybrids have good temperature tolerance ranges and venomous attacks.

这几乎是任何人从民间传说中重新演绎龙的最接近的一次。能够在严寒或酷暑中生存，唯一真正缺少的是一双翅膀和天生的欲望囤积成堆的黄金作为巢穴。事实上，它不是肉食性的，而是喜欢吃蔬菜和木纤维。

一种带有隐性爬行动物基因的巨型杂交种。这种混血儿的嘴里滴着毒液，身体上覆盖着坚韧而灵活的鳞片，这种混血儿是一种令人讨厌、极其耐用的战斗混血儿。如果这还不够，它还能喷出有毒烟雾，并以欺骗性的速度快速移动。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color>所有巨型混种的攻击速度都很慢，但攻击力却很强，并拥有天生的护甲。所有爬行动物杂交体都具有良好的温度耐受范围和毒液攻击能力。

text:
Practically an overgrown and intelligent pest capable of tunnelling underground, so not even a nuke could clear an infestation. And it truly would be an infestation, as it has a gestation period measured in days rather than weeks, with a single breeding pair capable of wiping out an entire agricultural planet.

A colossal hybrid with recessive rodent genes. Incredibly durable and fast breeding, this surprisingly small hybrid can work as a durable screening force. One of the weakest colossal hybrids in terms of attack power but very few can outlast its incredibly robust physique.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All colossal hybrids have very slow attacks, but hit very hard, and possess natural armor. Burrow underground: Thrumborats can burrow underground to make them almost immune to damage for a short while.

translated:
实际上是一种生长茂盛且聪明的害虫，能够在地下挖隧道，因此即使是核武器也无法清除感染。这确实是一种侵扰，因为它的妊娠期以天而不是周为单位，单个繁殖对就能够消灭整个农业星球。

一种带有隐性啮齿动物基因的巨大杂交种。这种令人惊讶的小型杂交种具有令人难以置信的耐用性和快速繁殖能力，可以作为持久的筛选力量。攻击力最弱的巨型混合体之一，但很少有人能比其强健的体格更持久。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color>所有巨型混合体的攻击速度都很慢，但攻击力却很强，并且拥有天生的护甲。钻入地下：巨蜥可以钻入地下，使其在短时间内几乎免受伤害。

text:
A very nice combination of two highly adaptive baseline creatures which arguably results in the best riding companion man could ask for. While this isn’t apparent in their speed, it definitely is so once a rider experiences the thundering beats of this horsey positively barreling through entire forests and marshland in order to earn its next sugar cube the size of a fist.

A colossal hybrid with recessive equine genes. While they have a lower muscle-to-fat ratio compared to their progenitor, the overall placement and shape of the horn vastly reduces their combat efficiency. Instead, they more than make up for this shortfall with an incredible endurance even compared to paragons. An excellent riding companion that is easier to train and can even carry an acceptable amount of luggage, the majority of which contains feed.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All equine hybrids are good for caravaning. A caravan with one of them needs a shorter resting period, only stopping to rest between 23:30 PM and 4 AM. Always starts as draftable, even if not using a controller booster to create it. Charge ability: when drafted, the player can use the charge ability to make the hybrid jump towards a target and cause massive damage with its horn to a single random body part. The ability can be triggered every 2 hours.

translated:
两种高度适应性基线生物的完美组合，可以说是人类所要求的最佳骑行伴侣。虽然这在它们的速度上并不明显，但一旦骑手体验到这匹马的雷鸣般的节奏，它就会积极地穿过整个森林和沼泽地，以获得下一个拳头大小的方糖。

一种具有隐性马基因的巨大杂交种。虽然与祖先相比，它们的肌肉发达的角色。脂肪比较低，但角的整体位置和形状极大地降低了它们的战斗效率。相反，即使与典范相比，他们也以令人难以置信的耐力弥补了这一缺陷。一个优秀的骑行伙伴，更容易训练，甚至可以携带可接受数量的行李，其中大部分含有饲料。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color>所有马种杂交都适合商队旅行。载有其中之一的商队需要的休息时间较短，仅在下午 23:30 至凌晨 4 点之间停下来休息。始终以可起草的方式启动，即使不使用控制器增强器来创建它。冲锋能力：当被选中时，玩家可以使用冲锋能力使混合体跳向目标，并用其角对单个随机身体部位造成巨大伤害。该能力每2小时可以触发一次。

text:
Look, we know what you want, a thrumbo that won’t eat your crops before they’ve harvested, thereby wasting entire seasons of growth for your most valuable plants. And we’re here to tell you it doesn’t exist. But we’ve gotten close in that this one will typically harvest your plants before it eats them for worse nutritional gain. Unless it’s trees, in which case we got nothing.

A colossal hybrid with recessive humanoid genes. Considerably easier to train and maintain, this particular hybrid will help around the colony by cutting and harvesting designated plants. Unusually lean for how much it eats, it won’t provide much in butchering.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Humanoid hybrids will periodically engage other colonists in conversation, talking about a variety of topics. This increases the social recreation needs of those they interact with by 10% (subject to diminishing returns like all joy types). If using Ideology, humanoid hybrids are subject to precepts. All colossal hybrids have very slow attacks, but hit very hard, and possess natural armor. Thrumbomen will obey orders to cut and harvest plants around the colony.

translated:
看，我们知道您想要什么，一种在收获前不会吃掉您的庄稼的敲击虫，从而浪费您最有价值的植物的整个生长季节。我们在这里告诉你它不存在。但我们已经很接近了，因为它通常会在吃掉你的植物之前收割它们，以获得更差的营养增益。除非是树，否则我们什么也得不到。

具有隐性人形基因的巨大杂交体。这种特殊的杂交种非常容易训练和维护，通过切割和收获指定的植物来帮助周围的殖民地。它吃的量异常稀少，在屠宰中不会提供太多帮助。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color>人形混血儿会定期与其他殖民者交谈，谈论各种话题。这使得与之互动的人的社交娱乐需求增加了 10%（与所有快乐类型一样，收益递减）。如果使用意识形态，人形混种人必须遵守戒律。所有巨型混合体的攻击速度都很慢，但攻击力却很强，并且拥有天生的盔甲。 Thrumbomen 将服从命令砍伐和收获殖民地周围的植物。

text:
While they’re surprisingly tireless when they have a home to rest at, these manned mares are quite reluctant to hurry along when made to carry loads in a caravan. Their body’s efficiency means they’ll get a task done when it needs to, and not a moment sooner. What makes it worse is that they’re smart enough to know that they’re cute - and powerful - enough to get away with it.

An equine hybrid with recessive ursine genes. The inherent hibernating nature of bears has combined with the high energy of horses to create this particular hybrid that requires little in the way of rest and a much more efficient and versatile digestive system. They are quite a bit slower as a consequence, along with their higher body mass.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All equine hybrids are good for caravaning. A caravan with one of them needs a shorter resting period, only stopping to rest between 23:30 PM and 4 AM.

虽然当它们有家休息时，它们会不知疲倦地不知疲倦，但当这些载人母马在大篷车中搬运货物时，它们却不愿意匆忙前行。他们身体的效率意味着他们会在需要时完成任务，而不是时刻更快。更糟糕的是，它们足够聪明，知道自己很可爱，而且很强大，足以逃脱惩罚。

具有隐性熊基因的马杂交种。熊固有的冬眠本性与马的高能量相结合，创造出这种特殊的混合体，它几乎不需要休息，并且拥有更高效和多功能的消化系统。因此，它们的速度要慢一些，体重也更高。

当允许闲暇时休息时，提炼化学燃料的效率本质上较低，同时也是良好的驮畜和骑马伙伴。在长途旅行中，肌肉发达的角色。的长时间活动会导致腺体过度运转。如果有一种使用化学燃料的车辆会非常有效，但不要问这会如何运作。也许是欲望与机器竞争，或者知道如果车辆发生故障，它就不得不再次进行所有该死的行走。

具有隐性boomalope基因的马杂交种。虽然它们相对较慢，但它们固有的锻炼需求意味着，如果它们的肌肉发达的角色。长时间不活动，它们生产化学燃料的能力就会受到严重阻碍。当作为商队旅行时，它们的化学燃料生产速度实际上会增加四倍。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color>所有马种混血儿都适合商队。载有其中之一的商队需要的休息时间较短，仅在下午 23:30 至凌晨 4 点之间停下来休息。

text:
An agile avian that most people expect to be more yellow in colour and go “wark” every now and then. A delightfully speedy mount that can pull off some impressive turns, this hybrid has been bred even further with other species to make for more colourful and genetically stable bird mounts. Some speculate that this particular creature is the original ancestor of the Ave, while the Royal Ave came from those that were bred more for plumage than performance.

An equine hybrid with recessive avian genes. Comparatively smaller than a purebred, but incredibly fast both in a singular location and as part of a caravan. A rather unusual hybrid in that it reproduces very slowly in a safe, similar environment, however this changes on caravan trips. Constant new sights and experiences puts their reproductive cycle into overdrive as it tries to spread its species over a broad horizon, however these eggs are genetically sterile so that they instead provide a healthy protein supplement for those who can only gather fruits and vegetables.

translated:
一种敏捷的鸟类，大多数人期望它的颜色更黄，并且时不时地“鸣叫”。这种坐骑速度快得令人愉悦，可以完成一些令人印象深刻的转弯，这种杂交鸟已经与其他物种进一步培育，以形成色彩更加鲜艳且基因稳定的鸟类坐骑。一些人推测，这种特殊的生物是 Ave 的原始祖先，而 Royal Ave 则来自那些更多地为了羽毛而非性能而培育的动物。

一种带有隐性鸟类基因的马杂种。比纯种马要小一些，但无论是在单一地点还是作为大篷车的一部分，速度都快得令人难以置信。这是一种相当不寻常的混合体，因为它在安全、相似的环境中繁殖非常缓慢，但这种情况在商队旅行时会发生变化。不断的新景象和经历使它们的繁殖周期超速运转，因为它试图将自己的物种传播到广阔的地平线上，然而这些蛋在基因上是不育的，因此它们反而为那些只能采集水果和蔬菜的人提供了健康的蛋白质补充剂。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color>所有马种杂交都适合商队。载有其中之一的商队需要的休息时间较短，仅在下午 23:30 至凌晨 4 点之间停下来休息。

text:
Tell me, do you want a cat large enough to ride at speeds that would be illegal on most urbworld city streets? Of course you do, and if you say otherwise you’re a coward. This ferocious feline is ready to tear up the track and hunt prey comically smaller than itself. They’re also incredibly smart and have a tendency to stalk their owners when their backs are turned. Don’t worry though, it only wants to pin you down and drown you in fur and saliva.

An equine hybrid with recessive feline genes. Quite durable and combat capable for a pack animal, they can be drafted to execute at-will pouncing to close distance with the enemy. They are only slightly less effective as horses in riding but have better stamina, in exchange they are pure carnivores so their diet can be rather restrictive.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All equine hybrids are good for caravaning. A caravan with one of them needs a shorter resting period, only stopping to rest between 23:30 PM and 4 AM. Like all cat hybrids, they have an improved melee dodge ability, making them perfect for the front lines, and a short nuzzle period. Always starts as draftable, even if not using a controller booster to create it. Pounce ability: when drafted, the player can use the pounce ability to make the hybrid jump around. The ability can be triggered every 2 hours.

translated:
告诉我，你想要一辆足够大的 猫🐈 来以在大多数都市世界城市街道上非法的速度骑行吗？你当然知道，如果你不这么说，那你就是个胆小鬼。这只凶猛的猫科动物已经准备好撕毁轨道并捕猎比自己小得可笑的猎物。它们也非常聪明，当主人转身时，它们往往会跟踪主人。不过别担心，它只是想把你困住，然后把你淹没在毛皮和将相当数量的口腔分泌物用于性目的。舔食或吐痰不算在内。中。

具有隐性猫科动物基因的马杂交种。对于驮类动物来说，它们非常耐用且具有战斗能力，可以随意地向敌人近距离猛扑。它们的骑行效率略低于马，但耐力更好，但它们是纯肉食动物，因此饮食会受到相当严格的限制。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color>所有马种杂交都适合商队旅行。载有其中之一的商队需要的休息时间较短，仅在下午 23:30 至凌晨 4 点之间停下来休息。像所有猫混合体一样，它们具有改进的近战闪避能力，使它们非常适合前线，并且交战时间短。始终以可起草的方式启动，即使不使用控制器增强器来创建它。突袭能力：选中时，玩家可以使用突袭能力使混合体跳跃。该能力每2小时可以触发一次。

text:
An oversized naked mole-rat with frighteningly large chompers, however they’re not as dangerous as they look as they are quite timid and use said teeth for chewing up tough vegetables. Objectively cute when you give them a good brushing, but have a nasty habit of overshooting hand-fed snacks and biting on hands due to poor eyesight. A saddle is recommended for riding, as there is little fat and no fur to cushion their boney structure and loose skin.

An equine hybrid with recessive rodent genes. Quite small and lacking in durability, but surprisingly capable as a mount. Exceedingly filthy for an animal that eats so little, however this is tied to its rapid gestation and faint regenerative capabilities.

一种超大的裸鼹鼠，有着大得可怕的咀嚼器，但它们并不像看起来那么危险，因为它们非常胆小，用这些牙齿咀嚼坚硬的蔬菜。当你给它们好好刷牙时，客观上很可爱，但由于视力不佳，它们有过度喂食零食和咬手的坏习惯。建议使用马鞍进行骑行，因为脂肪很少，也没有毛皮来缓冲其骨骼结构和松弛的皮肤。

具有隐性啮齿动物基因的马杂交种。相当小且缺乏耐用性，但作为坐骑的能力却令人惊讶。对于吃得这么少的动物来说，太脏了，但这与它的快速妊娠和微弱的再生能力有关。

text:
Combining two of the most renowned endurance hunters in human history has resulted in man’s best friend whom you can also ride into battle with. Needless to say, the creation of this capricious canine was celebrated by many wealthy families who otherwise caused unfortunate accidents when they tried to ride their household dog when they clearly became too old or heavy for them to carry. What was not appreciated was their tendency to overestimate their - admittedly formidable - predatory capabilities.

An equine hybrid with recessive canine genes. A fast and ferocious dedicated carnivore sharing the hyperactive nature of sled dogs. Requires slightly more frequent retraining compared to similar hybrids but is overall better due to not having any extra features.

人类历史上两位最著名的耐力猎人的结合，造就了人类最好的朋友，你也可以和他一起战斗。不用说，这种反复无常的狗的诞生受到了许多富裕家庭的欢迎，否则，当他们试图骑着家养的狗时，因为它们显然太老了或太重了，无法携带，否则会造成不幸的事故。没有人意识到的是，它们倾向于高估它们的捕食能力——诚然是强大的——掠夺能力。

与隐性犬科动物基因杂交的马科动物。一种快速而凶猛的食肉动物，具有雪橇犬过度活跃的本性。与类似的混合马相比，需要稍微频繁的再训练，但由于没有任何额外的功能，总体上更好。

text:
Belligerent bulls with a penchant for the tastes of the wild wastes. A herd of these creatures can be occasionally seen trawling through regions, consuming practically all edible vegetation and leaving fertile waste in their path. Some argue that this is the ideal form of muffalo for nomad tribes, as they produce everything they need to survive winters and are large enough to feed said tribe through the harshest of seasons.

An equine hybrid with recessive muffalo genes. Very unusual in that it doesn’t help a caravan speed along, largely due to it excessively foraging and eating various vegetation from new locations, as well as roughage to help with digestion. The benefit from this behaviour is that this stimulation is the only way it’ll produce milk and wool, so herds of these hybrids can be taken on a long journey to provide produce vital to small and starting colonies.

好战的公牛，喜欢品尝野生荒原的味道。偶尔可以看到一群这些生物在地区拖网捕鱼，几乎吃掉所有可食用的植物，并在它们的路径上留下肥沃的废物。一些人认为，这是游牧部落理想的野牛形式，因为它们生产过冬所需的一切，而且体型足够大，可以在最严酷的季节为所述部落提供食物。

具有隐性野牛基因的马杂交种。非常不寻常的是，它不能帮助商队加速前进，很大程度上是因为它过度地觅食和吃来自新地点的各种植物，以及帮助消化的粗饲料。这种行为的好处是，这种刺激是它产生牛奶和羊毛的唯一方式，因此这些杂交马群可以进行长途旅行，为小型和初始群体提供至关重要的农产品。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color>所有马杂交都适合商队。载有其中之一的商队需要的休息时间较短，仅在下午 23:30 至凌晨 4 点之间停下来休息。

text:
A rather muscular hybrid with an impressively long snout, this ravenous reptile combines adaptability with mobility. Unusually, its terrifyingly long maw filled with curved teeth is not used to tear flesh to eat but to imbue toxins and the required muscles to spray those toxins out. This means they have to eat a lot more due to their subpar digestive system and their favourite activities include lounging in the sun and moving with disturbing quickness when the dinner bell is sounded. Also it… kinda looks like a weird shoe if you look at it, but, uh, don’t put your foot in there.

An equine hybrid with recessive reptile genes. A rather slow hybrid for its category, its main advantage is that it is very durable and it has a ranged toxic breath attack. Quite durable and comfortable in a wide range of temperatures, they present a hidden danger for those foolish enough to attack an otherwise easy target.

translated:
这种贪婪的爬行动物是一种肌肉发达的角色。发达的混合体，有着令人印象深刻的长鼻子，兼具适应性和机动性。不同寻常的是，它可怕的长嘴里充满了弯曲的牙齿，不是用来撕肉吃的，而是用来注入毒素和喷出这些毒素所需的肌肉发达的角色。。这意味着他们必须吃更多的东西，因为他们的消化系统较差，而且他们最喜欢的活动包括躺在阳光下，以及当晚餐铃声响起时以令人不安的速度移动。还有……如果你看它的话，它看起来有点像一只奇怪的鞋子，但是，呃，不要把你的脚放进去。

一种带有隐性爬行动物基因的马杂交种。对于同类产品而言，这是一种相当缓慢的混合动力，其主要优点是非常耐用，并且具有远程有毒呼吸攻击能力。它们在各种温度下都相当耐用和舒适，但对于那些愚蠢到攻击本来很容易的目标的人来说却是一个隐患。

text:

一种带有隐性类昆虫基因的马杂交种。这是此类车辆中相当缓慢且肮脏的混合动力，但由于多条腿减轻了大篷车固有的长途旅行负担，因此它作为一种乘车方式非常有效。然而，它们的主要优点是，它们的战斗能力也令人难以置信，身披装甲，能够通过发射粘丝球来造成高伤害和远程眩晕攻击。

一个被极度诅咒的骑乘伙伴，可以用声音详细地解释它作为负担的野兽所经历的麻烦。大多数人不喜欢被提醒动物有感觉，尤其是当它们能用人类语言表达自己的声音时。如果没有人想吃或穿这种生物被屠宰的部分，请不要感到惊讶，因为它看起来像一个双手分叉的畸形人类。

这是您遇到过的最可爱的小猫 猫🐈，它们被培育成小看护者来照顾医院病房里的人们。尽管违反了健康规定，但它们却非常受体弱者的欢迎，因为它们不仅给病人喂食，而且还与人交谈并友好地用头撞。据称，它们的咕噜声有助于破碎骨头愈合得更快，但尚未显示确凿的证据。

具有隐性人形基因的猫科动物杂交种。相对而言，相当缓慢且脆弱，伤害输出较低，饥饿率较低。然而，它们是病人的很好的床边伴侣，并且会定期喂养那些无法自己进食的人。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color>人形混血儿会定期与其他殖民者交谈，谈论各种话题。这使得与之互动的人的社交娱乐需求增加了 10%（与所有快乐类型一样，收益递减）。如果使用意识形态，人形混种人必须遵守戒律。猫人是富有同情心的动物，可以帮助为殖民地周围的病人提供食物。
有猫耳，可能有猫尾或其他猫的特征。

text:
What it lacks in ferocity, it makes up for in tenacity and formidable cuteness. What person, sane or insane, could reject the diplomatic arguments presented by a waist-high teddy bear with a face just begging to be pinched. Not that you actually would, as those sharp teeth remind one that it very likely prefers to debate with its food before eating it.

A humanoid hybrid with recessive ursine genes. Absolutely terrible in combat potential despite its genetic material, but it is surprisingly adept at convincing prisoners to join the colony.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Humanoid hybrids will periodically engage other colonists in conversation, talking about a variety of topics. This increases the social recreation needs of those they interact with by 10% (subject to diminishing returns like all joy types). If using Ideology, humanoid hybrids are subject to precepts. Menbear are adept conversationalists and will help in recruiting prisoners.

translated:
它缺乏凶猛，但却以坚韧和令人敬畏的可爱来弥补。哪个人，无论神志清醒还是精神错乱，能够拒绝一只齐腰高、脸乞求捏捏的泰迪熊提出的外交论点。事实并非如此，因为那些锋利的牙齿提醒人们，它很可能更喜欢在吃食物之前与食物进行辩论。

一种具有隐性熊基因的人形杂交体。尽管拥有遗传物质，但战斗潜力绝对可怕，但它在说服囚犯加入殖民地方面却出人意料地擅长。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color>人形混血儿会定期与其他殖民者交谈，谈论各种话题。这使得与之互动的人的社交娱乐需求增加了 10%（与所有快乐类型一样，收益递减）。如果使用意识形态，人形混种人必须遵守戒律。熊人是善于交谈的人，会帮助招募囚犯。

text:
A floating, ticking time bomb that produces extremely reactive chemicals instead of chemfuel. Arguably more of a complex chemical distillery than an animal, it's a scientific miracle that it doesn’t explode every time it coughs. Surprisingly effective in combat in ways the enemy would really have preferred not knowing.

A humanoid hybrid with recessive boomalope genes. Thanks to its sac filled with buoyant chemicals, this hybrid never touches the ground and simply floats from location to location. Ignores terrain penalty costs and traps, while also being able to set down explosive traps of its own.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Humanoid hybrids will periodically engage other colonists in conversation, talking about a variety of topics. This increases the social recreation needs of those they interact with by 10% (subject to diminishing returns like all joy types). If using Ideology, humanoid hybrids are subject to precepts. Set trap ability: once every 3 days the manalope can set up an explosive IED. Hovers over terrain, ignoring terrain costs, and doesn't trigger ANY traps.

translated:
一种漂浮的、滴答作响的定时炸弹，会产生极其活跃的化学物质而不是化学燃料。可以说，它更像是一个复杂的化学蒸馏厂，而不是动物，它每次咳嗽时都不会爆炸，这是一个科学奇迹。在战斗中出人意料地有效，其方式是敌人宁愿不知道的。

具有隐性 boomalope 基因的人形混合体。由于其囊中充满了有浮力的化学物质，这种混合物永远不会接触地面，只是从一个地方漂浮到另一个地方。忽略地形惩罚成本和陷阱，同时也能够设置自己的爆炸陷阱。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color>人形混合体会定期与其他殖民者交谈，谈论各种话题。这使得与之互动的人的社交娱乐需求增加了 10%（与所有快乐类型一样，收益递减）。如果使用意识形态，人形混种人必须遵守戒律。设置陷阱能力：每三天一次，曼纳洛普可以设置一个爆炸性简易爆炸装置。悬停在地形上，忽略地形成本，并且不会触发任何陷阱。

text:
“You know how, like, chicken tastes, like, so good? So what if, like, we made a chicken that, y’know, when you killed it you could, I dunno, stuff it right in your mouth as fried chicken? Dude, this shit is the shit, where did you get this, man?” - Recording playback used in a hearing against a disgraced genetic scientist for misappropriating government funding.

A humanoid hybrid with recessive avian genes. A very valuable hybrid that convinces people that its greatest desire in life is to be eaten. When butchered, it leaves large amounts of completely healthy and nutritious meat that can be eaten as-is.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Humanoid hybrids will periodically engage other colonists in conversation, talking about a variety of topics. This increases the social recreation needs of those they interact with by 10% (subject to diminishing returns like all joy types). If using Ideology, humanoid hybrids are subject to precepts. Doesn't lay eggs, but can be butchered for large amounts of a very nutritive meat that doesn't have poisoning chance and takes 6 days to rot.

translated:
“你知道，鸡肉的味道，就像，那么好吃吗？那么，如果，比如，我们做了一只鸡，你知道，当你杀了它之后，我不知道，你可以把它当作炸鸡塞进你的嘴里吗？伙计，这狗屎就是狗屎，你从哪里得到这个，伙计？” - 在针对一名因挪用政府资金而名誉扫地的基因科学家的听证会上使用的录音回放。

具有隐性鸟类基因的人形杂交体。这是一个非常有价值的混合体，它让人们相信生命中最大的欲望就是被吃掉。屠宰后，会留下大量完全健康且营养丰富的肉，可以直接食用。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color>人形混血儿会定期与其他殖民者交谈，谈论各种话题。这使得与之互动的人的社交娱乐需求增加了 10%（与所有快乐类型一样，收益递减）。如果使用意识形态，人形混种人必须遵守戒律。不产卵，但可以大量宰杀，获得营养丰富的肉，不会中毒，并且需要 6 天才能腐烂。

text:
Considered a straight upgrade from their progenitor, featured several times in Cannibal Monthly. Produces appreciable amounts of wool and milk, it is a living, breathing reference to the phrase “what does not kill me makes me stronger”. At least, when it comes to hauling large loads, which is all some people care about.

A humanoid hybrid with recessive muffalo genes. Capable of surviving very high temperatures in opposition to the traditional use of muffalos, this hybrid performs below average for a pack animal. However, due to adaptive muscle and skeletal structure, the more it participates as part of a caravan, the heavier the load it can withstand.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Humanoid hybrids will periodically engage other colonists in conversation, talking about a variety of topics. This increases the social recreation needs of those they interact with by 10% (subject to diminishing returns like all joy types). If using Ideology, humanoid hybrids are subject to precepts. The manffalo starts as a poor caravaning animal, but learns as time progresses. Every hour spent in a caravan will increase its cargo capacity by 1%, up to a maximum of a 100% increase from base.

translated:
被认为是其祖先的直接升级版，在《食人月刊》中多次出现。生产大量的羊毛和牛奶，这是对“杀不死我的，使我更坚强”这句话的活生生的引用。至少，在运输大负载方面，这是一些人所关心的。

具有隐性野牛基因的人形混血儿。与传统使用的野牛不同，这种杂交种能够在非常高的温度下生存，但其表现低于群居动物的平均水平。然而，由于肌肉发达的角色。和骨骼结构的适应性，它作为商队的一部分参与得越多，它能承受的负载就越重。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color>人形混种会定期与其他殖民者交谈，谈论各种话题。这使得与之互动的人的社交娱乐需求增加了 10%（与所有快乐类型一样，收益递减）。如果使用意识形态，人形混种人必须遵守戒律。曼法罗一开始只是一种可怜的商队动物，但随着时间的推移，它学会了。在商队中每花费一小时，其载货量就会增加 1%，最多从基础增加 100%。

text:
Possibly either the ancestor to the warg or an attempt at creating a successor, the team in charge of making this particular hybrid clearly had read one to many mythological novels. Arguably there’s no transformation at the full moon, so you just get the permanent single form, but there’s no pleasing some people.

A humanoid hybrid with recessive canine genes. A fast and dangerous hunter with almost misplaced self-confidence. Also very intelligent and possessing faint regenerative capabilities. Extremely hardy but also extremely restrictive in their diet.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Humanoid hybrids will periodically engage other colonists in conversation, talking about a variety of topics. This increases the social recreation needs of those they interact with by 10% (subject to diminishing returns like all joy types). If using Ideology, humanoid hybrids are subject to precepts.

translated:
可能是座狼的祖先，也可能是为了创造一个继承者，负责制作这种特殊混合体的团队显然读过很多神话小说。可以说满月时没有转变，所以你只能得到永久的单一形态，但无法取悦某些人。

具有隐性犬科基因的人形混血儿。一个快速而危险的猎人，几乎失去了自信。而且非常聪明，具有微弱的再生能力。极其耐寒，但饮食也极其严格。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color>人形混血儿会定期与其他殖民者交谈，谈论各种话题。这使得与之互动的人的社交娱乐需求增加了 10%（与所有快乐类型一样，收益递减）。如果使用意识形态，人形混种人必须遵守戒律。

text:
A creature originally designed for other recreational purposes before that particular laboratory of degenerates got glassed from orbit, they make for an affectionate conversation partner. You know, probably, most likely, until their particular speech pattern grinds on your nerves like a cheese grater.

A humanoid hybrid with recessive feline genes. A surprisingly large yet timid predator that can output a disturbing amount of damage. Typically fun to talk to, but 10% of the time it tries to be a little too cute.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Like all cat hybrids, they have an improved melee dodge ability and a short nuzzle period. Humanoid hybrids will periodically engage other colonists in conversation, talking about a variety of topics. This increases the social recreation needs of those they interact with (subject to diminishing returns like all joy types). In the case of the mancat, these interactions will 90% of the time increase the targets' social joy by 15%, but the rest of the time they'll just make the target very annoyed... If using Ideology, humanoid hybrids are subject to precepts.

translated:
在那个特定的堕落实验室被从轨道上玻璃化之前，这种生物最初是为了其他娱乐目的而设计的，它们是一个深情的谈话伙伴。你可能知道，很可能，直到他们特殊的言语模式像奶酪刨丝器一样磨碎你的神经。

具有隐性猫科动物基因的人形混血儿。一种体型惊人但胆怯的掠食者，可以造成令人不安的伤害。通常与人交谈很有趣，但有 10% 的时间它会表现得有点太可爱了。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color> 与所有 猫🐈 混合体一样，它们具有改进的近战闪避能力和较短的碰撞时间。人形混血儿会定期与其他殖民者交谈，谈论各种话题。这增加了与他们互动的人的社交娱乐需求（像所有快乐类型一样，收益递减）。就曼猫而言，这些互动在 90% 的时间里会让目标的社交快乐增加 15%，但在其余的时间里，它们只会让目标非常恼火……如果使用意识形态，人形混血儿就会受到戒律的约束。

text:
A bloody weird little thing that hates the cold with a passion, and will take any opportunity to clear away snow from its home. Given that they are active at nighttime, they make a great conversational companion for those otherwise asocial Night Owls you keep gathering.

A humanoid hybrid with recessive rodent genes. Quite quick for their size and unusually a nocturnal animal, they make for a fast, social and quick-breeding hybrid. Will shovel snow if there are Clear Snow zones set up.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Humanoid hybrids will periodically engage other colonists in conversation, talking about a variety of topics. This increases the social recreation needs of those they interact with by 10% (subject to diminishing returns like all joy types). If using Ideology, humanoid hybrids are subject to precepts. The mansquirrel is a nocturnal animal that sleeps during the day. Will obey orders to clear snow around the colony.

translated:
一个该死的怪异小东西，讨厌寒冷热情，并且会抓住任何机会清除家里的积雪。鉴于它们在夜间很活跃，因此对于您不断聚集的那些不合群的夜猫子来说，它们是一个很好的对话伙伴。

具有隐性啮齿动物基因的人形混合体。相对于它们的体型来说，它们的速度相当快，而且是一种不同寻常的夜行动物，它们是一种快速、社交和快速繁殖的杂交种。如果设置了晴雪区域，就会铲雪。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color>人形混血儿会定期与其他殖民者交谈，谈论各种话题。这使得与之互动的人的社交娱乐需求增加了 10%（与所有快乐类型一样，收益递减）。如果使用意识形态，人形混种人必须遵守戒律。曼松鼠是一种夜行性动物，白天睡觉。会服从命令清除殖民地周围的积雪。

text:
An absolute unit of an insectoid hybrid, this massive chubster is incredibly smart and hard to kill. All the excess blubber has been replaced with either chitin or muscle fibre, so don’t go making comments about their bulk.

An insectoid hybrid with recessive ursine genes. Very thick armour plating and a calm temperament make this hybrid an excellent combat animal. Requires little in the way of retraining and can dish out respectable damage as well.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All insectoid hybrids have good armor and no toxic sensitivity, but they are always sterile and can't reproduce, even if a fertility booster is used to create them.

translated:
这种巨大的大嘴虫绝对是类昆虫杂交体，非常聪明且难以杀死。所有多余的鲸脂都已被几丁质或肌肉发达的角色。纤维取代，所以不要对它们的体积发表评论。

具有隐性熊基因的类昆虫杂交体。非常厚的装甲和冷静的性情使这种混种成为优秀的战斗动物。几乎不需要再训练，也能造成可观的伤害。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color>所有类昆虫杂种都具有良好的装甲并且没有毒性敏感性，但它们总是不育且无法繁殖，即使使用生育增强剂来创造它们也是如此。

text:
For lovers of xenomorphs everywhere, this bomb-ass bombadier is ready to launch sacs of acidic chemfuel at your enemies for fun and profit. Don’t expect a second pair of jaws though, that mouth is for spitting only.

An insectoid hybrid with recessive boomalope genes. Quite temperamental for a hybrid, but they prove to be worth it as they store caustic chemfuel in their sacs which can then be lobbed at a distance. Practically useless in melee, so keep them safe and provide fire support. Can be ordered to detonate auxiliary acid sacs as a defensive measure, but that will also self-harm.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All insectoid hybrids have good armor and no toxic sensitivity, but they are always sterile and can't reproduce, even if a fertility booster is used to create them.

translated:
对于世界各地的异形爱好者来说，这个炸弹-屁股投弹手已经准备好向你的敌人发射酸性化学燃料囊，以获取乐趣和利润。不过，不要指望有第二对下巴，那张嘴只是用来吐痰的。

一种带有隐性 boomalope 基因的昆虫杂交体。对于混合动力来说相当喜怒无常，但事实证明它们是值得的，因为它们在囊中储存了腐蚀性化学燃料，然后可以将其抛向远处。在近战中几乎没有用，所以要保证他们的安全并提供火力支援。可以命令引爆辅助酸囊作为防御措施，但这也会造成自残。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color>所有昆虫杂种都拥有良好的装甲并且没有毒性敏感性，但它们始终是不育的并且无法繁殖，即使使用生育增强剂来创建它们也是如此。

text:
For the unusual connoisseur who both enjoys a healthy breakfast and the feel of silk pyjamas. A very niche market, but considering the amount of money paid for the development, people like that are too rich to be considered mad. They’re simply eccentric with refined tastes, or “tossers” as the disenfranchised call them.

An insectoid hybrid with recessive avian genes. Quite large and difficult to train for an animal that lays eggs, this particular hybrid should always be kept warm due to the various functions taking up valuable space. Capable of producing not only eggs but also valuable silk, and is protected by thin, flexible scales to resist cuts.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All insectoid hybrids have good armor and no toxic sensitivity, but they are always sterile and can't reproduce, even if a fertility booster is used to create them.

适合既享受健康早餐又享受丝绸睡衣感觉的非凡鉴赏家。这是一个非常小众的市场，但考虑到开发所支付的金额，这样的人太富有了，不能被认为是疯子。它们只是口味古怪，被剥夺权利的人称之为“扔东西”。(​​PH_6)
具有隐性鸟类基因的类昆虫杂交体。对于产卵动物来说，这种特殊的杂交动物相当大且难以训练，由于各种功能占用了宝贵的空间，因此应始终保持温暖。不仅能产卵，还能产有价值的丝，并有薄而柔韧的鳞片保护以抵抗割伤。

text:
An oversized grub with udders that extrude jelly instead of milk, its hard-headedness serves it well in both getting what it wants and nutting anyone foolish enough to think they’re better than them. Allegedly there was a case where the owner was prevented from shearing the creature for so long that the overlapping plates completely prevented it from moving, who was afterwards thanked with a kick in the nether region.

An insectoid hybrid with recessive muffalo genes. Higher metabolism compared to other insectoid hybrids as well as stubborn, any predator foolish enough to think of them as an easy meal will be responded with a headbutt like a sledgehammer. Can work as a pack animal but refuses to haul comparatively heavy loads. Regularly produces precious jelly and can be sheared for chitin, which overlaps and protects the animal well from blunt attacks.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All insectoid hybrids have good armor and no toxic sensitivity, but they are always sterile and can't reproduce, even if a fertility booster is used to create them.

这是一种体型巨大的幼虫，其乳房会挤出果冻而不是牛奶，它的顽固性既能得到它想要的东西，又能让那些愚蠢到认为自己比自己强的人感到厌烦。据称，有一个案例，主人长时间无法剪掉该生物的毛发，以至于重叠的板完全阻止了它移动，后来主人用脚踢了下体区域以表示谢意。

一种带有隐性野牛基因的类昆虫杂交体。与其他类昆虫杂种相比，它们的新陈代谢更高，而且很顽固，任何愚蠢到认为它们是一顿简单的饭菜的捕食者都会受到像大锤一样的头撞回应。可以作为驮畜，但拒绝搬运相对较重的货物。定期产生珍贵的果冻，可以剪切成几丁质，重叠并很好地保护动物免受钝器攻击。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color>所有类昆虫杂种都拥有良好的装甲并且没有毒性敏感性，但它们始终是不育的并且无法繁殖，即使使用生育增强剂来创建它们也是如此。

text:
The answer to all your worries about escaping slaves. These omnivorous vicious beasties are effectively exotic hunting dogs, and the most exotic and forbidden prey of all is humans. That is, provided they’re practically unable to defend themselves. Everyone knows you can kill as many people as you like, just don’t hurt the poor puppy trying to tear your throat out.

An insectoid hybrid with recessive canine genes. Incredibly fast and with multiple hardened jaw plates, these ferocious hunting dogs make for an excellent, intelligent combat hybrid. Unable to take much punishment but the armour plating should help against those lacking in offensive weaponry.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All insectoid hybrids have good armor and no toxic sensitivity, but they are always sterile and can't reproduce, even if a fertility booster is used to create them.

text:
They say you can learn a lot by taking something apart and putting it back together again. Not this creature, it doesn’t give a damn, it just wants to take things apart because the hardest part is someone else’s problem. Some people actually prefer these chitinous creatures over actual humans as they’re not going to use up good material in a botched attempt.

An insectoid hybrid with recessive humanoid genes. Easy to train, quite resilient but not a great combatant. This particular hybrid fills the niche of fulfilling deconstruction orders around the colony, freeing up otherwise valuable manpower.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Humanoid hybrids will periodically engage other colonists in conversation, talking about a variety of topics. This increases the social recreation needs of those they interact with by 10% (subject to diminishing returns like all joy types). If using Ideology, humanoid hybrids are subject to precepts. All insectoid hybrids have good armor and no toxic sensitivity, but they are always sterile and can't reproduce, even if a fertility booster is used to create them. Menscarab will take building deconstruction orders around the colony.

这是一个令人难以置信的大毛皮宝宝，它不仅想让你挠它的肚子，而且还经常挠它，而不用担心它的巨大爪子会挖出你的眼睛。此外，它们也足够聪明，可以追捕小于自己一半大小的猎物，但更重要的是，它们之后不必花太多时间梳理自己。

完美的猫科动物，是所有类似动物的典范，没有不必要的垃圾遗传数据。除了对基础动物能力的各种改进之外，这只典范还非常聪明，只需最少的再训练即可得到适当的训练，并且是一个优秀而深情的伴侣。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color>像所有猫🐈混合体一样，它们具有改进的近战闪避能力和较短的碰撞时间。猫反射能力：每天两次，它可以使用赋予其进一步近战能力的能力。

text:
A terrifying callback to the original Sorne geneline, this mobile hive was originally designed to engage the mechanoid enemy head-on. By carrying an entire colony of insects with hardened mandibles, their ability to practically disassemble the mechanical menace proved just as effective at turning against their human overlords.

A perfect insectoid animal, paragon of all similar animals with no needless junk genetic data. Besides the various improvements to the baseline animal’s abilities, this paragon is extremely intelligent and carries a dangerous brood of warrior flies. A burst of pheromones summons the drones to protect their hive and queen, shredding apart all other nearby creatures.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All insectoid hybrids have good armor and no toxic sensitivity, but they are always sterile and can't reproduce, even if a fertility booster is used to create them. Insect clouds ability: twice a day it can create insect clouds around it that damage any animal crossing them, except insectoid paragons, which are immune.

translated:
这个移动蜂巢是对原始索恩基因的可怕回调，最初设计用于与机械敌人正面交战。通过携带一整群下颌坚硬的昆虫，它们实际上能够分解机械威胁，事实证明它们在对抗人类霸主方面同样有效。

完美的类昆虫动物，是所有类似动物的典范，没有不必要的垃圾遗传数据。除了对基础动物能力的各种改进之外，这种典范还非常聪明，并且携带着一群危险的武士蝇。一阵信息素召唤雄蜂来保护它们的蜂巢和蜂后，撕碎附近所有其他生物。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color>所有类昆虫杂种都拥有良好的装甲并且没有毒性敏感性，但它们总是不育且无法繁殖，即使使用生育增强剂来创造它们也是如此。昆虫云能力：每天两次，它可以在其周围制造昆虫云，对任何穿过昆虫云的动物造成伤害，除了类昆虫典范，它们是免疫的。

A reptile hybrid with recessive ursine genes. Highly intelligent and an exceptional frontline trooper, with a venomous, stunning attack, fast movement speed and high health pool.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All reptile hybrids have good temperature tolerance ranges and venomous attacks.

那里的恐龙书呆子应该喜欢这种混合体。被地狱狠狠地咬了一口，连爪子都会把你击倒，让你站不起来。通常由百分之一的无聊者饲养，他们想以穴居人的方式吃巨大的鸡腿。

一种带有隐性熊基因的爬行动物杂交种。高智商、出色的前线士兵，具有剧毒、惊人的攻击力、快速的移动速度和高生命值。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color>所有爬行动物混种都具有良好的温度耐受范围和剧毒攻击力。

text:
What happens when you mix a spitting cobra, a rattlesnake and a creature designed to lactate refined fuel? This abomination, that’s what. Drive it into a corner and it’ll hurt itself to release deadly neurotoxins. Try and keep your distance and it’ll spit toxic blood right at you. Clearly someone was a sore loser in playing pretend games as a child, but had either the brains or the money to prove themselves right.

A reptile hybrid with recessive boomalope genes. Decently intelligent with a nasty bite and even nastier ranged attack, both causing toxic buildup. Quite a high metabolism which supports its various combat abilities, best suited for home defence.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All reptile hybrids have good temperature tolerance ranges and venomous attacks.

当你把一条吐毒眼镜蛇、一条响尾蛇和一种能分泌精炼燃料的生物混合在一起时，会发生什么？这可憎之事，就是这样。把它逼到角落，它会伤害自己并释放致命的神经毒素。尝试保持距离，它会向你吐出有毒的血液。显然，有人在小时候玩过假装游戏，是个彻头彻尾的失败者，但他要么有头脑，要么有钱来证明自己是对的。

具有隐性 boomalope 基因的爬行动物杂交种。相当聪明，具有令人讨厌的咬合甚至更令人讨厌的远程攻击，两者都会导致毒性累积。相当高的新陈代谢支持其各种战斗能力，最适合家庭防御。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color>所有爬行动物混种都有良好的温度耐受范围和有毒攻击。

text:
Chickens are basically an evolution of dinosaurs, so someone decided to turn them back. Unfortunately they didn’t exactly bother to check that they should still be avian rather than reptilian, so it resulted in this nasty little thing that reproduces at an insane rate and empties your fridge. But hey, they’ll spit on your enemies and their right to shit everywhere, especially where they eat.

A reptile hybrid with recessive avian genes. This particular farm animal is smart enough that it doesn’t need a pen and breeds faster than other reptiles. A very large appetite for a creature so small, which supports its ability to spit out nasty toxins on their enemies and create messes on the floor. Very easy to train and has a good memory.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All reptile hybrids have good temperature tolerance ranges and venomous attacks.

具有隐性鸟类基因的爬行动物杂交体。这种特殊的农场动物非常聪明，不需要围栏，而且比其他爬行动物繁殖得更快。对如此小生物的胃口非常大，这支持了它向敌人吐出讨厌的毒素并在地板上制造混乱的能力。非常容易训练，记忆力很好。

text:
Milking snakes for venom in order to create medicine is an extremely dangerous career. While this particular beast of burden proved to be capable in other areas, it was mainly synthesised in order to provide a safer way of sourcing an anaesthetic coagulant to be used in emergencies. Or someone was trying to get high by milking a reptilian space cow, who really knows.

A reptile hybrid with recessive muffalo genes. A strong pack animal with a massive appetite and a proportionate filth rate. Quite durable and will prove a fatal mistake for any animal that attempts to hunt them, as their fangs, horns and claws are all venomous. Can be milked every ten days for a vial of paralysing coagulant, best used for large animals that are suffering from multiple lacerations.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All reptile hybrids have good temperature tolerance ranges and venomous attacks.

为了制造药物而从蛇中挤奶获取毒液是一项极其危险的职业。虽然这种特殊的负担在其他领域被证明是有能力的，但它的合成主要是为了提供一种更安全的方式来采购紧急情况下使用的麻醉凝固剂。或者有人试图通过挤奶一头爬行动物太空牛来获得兴奋，谁真正知道。

具有隐性穆法罗基因的爬行动物杂交体。一种强壮的群居动物，食欲旺盛，排污率也很高。非常耐用，对于任何试图猎杀它们的动物来说都是致命的错误，因为它们的尖牙、角和爪子都是有毒的。每十天可以挤奶一瓶麻痹凝固剂，最适合用于遭受多处撕裂伤的大型动物。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color>所有爬行动物杂交体都具有良好的温度耐受范围和毒性攻击。

So some insane madman decided to create a living creature that can synthesise its own neutroamine. Granted it’s not a lot, but have enough of these disturbingly powerful and quick cobras and no one will ever try to rob you, or live long enough to get away.

A reptile hybrid with recessive insectoid genes. For an animal so small, it has an incredibly powerful bite and can spit venom. Sadly they can’t be trained but will happily hunt smaller prey that happen to wander into their territory or fight back against any foolish predators. Can be milked once every several days for a vial of neutroamine, so they function well as part of a large drug farm.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All reptile hybrids have good temperature tolerance ranges and venomous attacks.

由于制造合成前体化学品需要无菌环境，中性胺的制造相当困难。于是，一些疯狂的疯子决定创造一种可以合成自己的中性胺的生物。虽然数量不多，但拥有足够多的这些令人不安的强大而敏捷的眼镜蛇，就不会有人试图抢劫你，也不会活得足够长而逃脱。

一种带有隐性类昆虫基因的爬行动物杂交种。对于如此小的动物来说，它的咬合力令人难以置信，并且可以吐出毒液。遗憾的是，它们无法接受训练，但会很高兴地捕猎碰巧闯入其领地的较小猎物，或反击任何愚蠢的掠食者。每隔几天可以挤奶一次，获得一瓶中性胺，因此它们可以作为大型毒品农场的一部分发挥良好作用。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color>所有爬行动物杂交体都具有良好的温度耐受范围和毒性攻击。

这是一种很棒的狗狗，它会脱落蛇皮而不是毛皮，所以当抓挠发痒的地方导致皮肤剥落时，不要太惊慌。即使在外出捕猎时，它也会自行脱落，所以要做好偶尔长途跋涉去拾取珍贵皮肤的准备。

太独立了，无法成为战斗动物，但肯定既可以发出又可以承受痛苦。在后台工作效果最好，专注于自己的业务并挖掘它发现的金属。没有人真正确定原因，但可能与那些巨大的胡须有关。

一种带有隐性熊基因的啮齿动物杂交种。独立的捕食者，新陈代谢极低，韧性很高。有一种不寻常的行为，它会定期挖掘宝藏，通常是原始金属。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color>所有啮齿类杂交动物都会快速妊娠，只要在基因变形器中创建它们时使用了生育解锁剂。

text:
It’s small, it’s cute, it’s a ticking time bomb waiting for some idiot to think it looks delicious. It’s not going to be a big explosion, but that doesn’t matter much when it’s in your mouth.

A rodent hybrid with recessive boomalope genes. Small, weak but fast, this hybrid suits those looking for a fuel production method in a small package. Produces chemfuel much more efficiently compared to a boomalope but it needs to be milked every day.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All rodent hybrids have fast gestation, as long as a fertility unblocker was used when creating them in the genomorpher.

translated:
它很小，很可爱，就像一颗定时炸弹，等待着一些白痴认为它看起来很美味。虽然不会发生大爆炸，但当它在你嘴里时，这并不重要。

一种带有隐性 boomalope 基因的啮齿动物杂交种。 小，弱但快，这种混合动力适合那些寻求小型燃料生产方法的人。与布玛洛普相比，它生产化学燃料的效率要高得多，但需要每天挤奶。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color>所有啮齿类杂交动物都可以快速妊娠，只要在基因变形器中创建它们时使用了生育解锁剂。

text:
Legends say of an ancient and vicious monster, a creature so foul, so cruel that no man yet has fought with it and lived. This was a somewhat successful attempt, as its weakness lulls the enemy into a false sense of security so that it can rip their throat out. So do you feel lucky, punk?

A rodent hybrid with recessive avian genes. A tiny, weak, fast-moving pest with an insane appetite for its size. Incredibly fast gestation period and a 1% chance to instantly kill when attacking.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All rodent hybrids have fast gestation, as long as a fertility unblocker was used when creating them in the genomorpher.

translated:
传说中有一种古老而邪恶的怪物，一种如此邪恶、如此残忍的生物，以至于还没有人与之战斗并生存下来。这是一次某种程度上成功的尝试，因为它的弱点让敌人产生一种虚假的安全感，从而可以撕断他们的喉咙。那么你觉得幸运吗，朋克？

带有隐性鸟类基因的啮齿动物杂交种。一种微小、虚弱、移动速度快的害虫，对其体型有着疯狂的胃口。令人难以置信的快速妊娠期，攻击时有 1% 的几率立即杀死。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color>所有啮齿类杂交动物都具有快速妊娠期，只要在基因变形器中创建它们时使用了生育解锁剂。

text:
An interesting pack animal that packs an incredible punch that also pisses and shits everywhere. That ain’t even the worst part, because these rodents of unusual size are also plague carriers with complete immunity to toxicity. Sometimes scientists just can’t leave well enough alone.

A rodent hybrid with recessive muffalo genes. Quite clever, almost absurdly lethal and quick on its feet. While they are herbivores, they will still happily munch on corpses thanks to their large appetite. Not as short a gestation period compared to other primary rodent hybrids, but every bite transmits the plague.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All rodent hybrids have fast gestation, as long as a fertility unblocker was used when creating them in the genomorpher.

translated:
一种有趣的群居动物，具有令人难以置信的力量，而且还到处撒尿和拉屎。这还不是最糟糕的部分，因为这些体型异常的啮齿动物也是鼠疫携带者，对毒性完全免疫。有时，科学家们就是无法置之不理。

一种带有隐性野牛基因的啮齿动物杂交种。非常聪明，致命性近乎荒谬，而且行动敏捷。虽然它们是食草动物，但由于胃口大，它们仍然会愉快地咀嚼尸体。与其他啮齿类杂种原代相比，妊娠期没有那么短，但每一口都会传播瘟疫。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color>所有啮齿类杂种都具有快速妊娠期，只要在基因变形器中创建它们时使用了生育解锁剂。

text:
An incredibly quick - mentally and physically - hunter with an overactive castoreum gland, effectively allowing them to actively convert meat and trees into vegetables. Technically vegans should be fine with it since, much like bees, it needs to be harvested and the beaverwolf will absolutely let you know if it doesn’t like you touching it.

A rodent hybrid with recessive canine genes. A very quick but cautious predator, this hybrid is both intelligent and frequently looking for its next meal. Able to freely roam and doesn’t require a pen, they are both carnivorous and dendrovorous while also offering daily harvests of castoreum which functions as a vegetable in dishes.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All rodent hybrids have fast gestation, as long as a fertility unblocker was used when creating them in the genomorpher.

translated:
一个在精神上和身体上都极其敏捷的猎人，海狸腺过于活跃，能够有效地将肉类和树木转化为蔬菜。从技术上讲，素食主义者应该对此没意见，因为就像蜜蜂一样，它需要被收获，而海狸狼绝对会让你知道它是否不喜欢你触摸它。

一种具有隐性犬科基因的啮齿动物杂交种。这种混合体是一种非常敏捷但谨慎的捕食者，它既聪明又经常寻找下一顿饭。它们能够自由漫游，不需要围栏，既是肉食性又是树食性的，同时还提供每日收获的海狸香，可作为菜肴中的蔬菜。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color>所有啮齿类杂交动物都可以快速妊娠，只要在基因变形器中创建它们时使用了生育解锁剂。

text:
For a combination of two relatively small animals, the rabbitcat is fucking massive and has a robust physique. It knows no fear and will tackle anything it wants to eat. Some say this was the other attempt to create the Rabbit of Caerbannog, because who says geneticists don’t have a sick sense of humour.

A rodent hybrid with recessive feline genes. Very intelligent considering the source material, these hybrids are fast, lethal and possess a robust physique with rapid natural regenerative capabilities. Quite stubborn so they require frequent, competent training but they aren’t afraid to show their appreciation.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Like all cat hybrids, they have an improved melee dodge ability and a short nuzzle period. All rodent hybrids have fast gestation, as long as a fertility unblocker was used when creating them in the genomorpher.

translated:
对于两种相对较小的动物的组合来说，兔猫体型巨大且体格健壮。它无所畏惧，会解决任何它想吃的东西。有人说这是创造卡尔班诺格兔子的另一次尝试，因为谁说遗传学家没有病态的幽默感。

一种带有隐性猫科动物基因的啮齿动物杂交种。考虑到来源材料，这些混合体非常聪明，速度快、致命，并拥有强健的体格和快速的自然再生能力。它们非常顽固，因此需要频繁、有能力的训练，但它们并不害怕表达自己的感激之情。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color>像所有猫🐈混合体一样，它们具有改进的近战闪避能力和较短的缠斗时间。所有啮齿类杂交动物的妊娠速度都很快，只要在基因变异体中创建它们时使用了生育力解锁剂。

text:
A hulking monstrosity that is genuinely caring for those around them, taking great joy and actual personal pleasure through working diligently and caring for those it considers friends and family. Evidently, it was bred specifically by megacorporations to work in dangerous mines, because human greed never changes.

A rodent hybrid with recessive humanoid genes. Very low hunger rate and very intelligent, these gentle giants enjoy digging with their hands. They will sometimes work mining orders given the chance but they’re very slow due to their bulk.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> Humanoid hybrids will periodically engage other colonists in conversation, talking about a variety of topics. This increases the social recreation needs of those they interact with by 10% (subject to diminishing returns like all joy types). If using Ideology, humanoid hybrids are subject to precepts. Molemen will periodically obey commands to mine. This will also work with the Quarry mod.

这是一个巨大的怪物，它真诚地关心周围的人，通过勤奋工作和关心它认为的朋友和家人来获得巨大的快乐和真正的个人快乐。显然，它是由大型企业专门培育出来在危险的矿山工作的，因为人类的贪婪永远不会改变。

具有隐性人形基因的啮齿动物杂交种。饥饿率极低，而且非常聪明，这些温柔的巨人喜欢用手挖掘。如果有机会，他们有时会执行采矿订单，但由于体积庞大，速度非常慢。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color>人形混血儿会定期与其他殖民者交谈，谈论各种话题。这使得与之互动的人的社交娱乐需求增加了 10%（与所有快乐类型一样，收益递减）。如果使用意识形态，人形混种人必须遵守戒律。鼹鼠会定期服从我的命令。这也适用于 Quarry 模组。

text:
An unusual concoction of traits that was favoured by a particular client who was obsessed on making things explode. Earned the nickname Boom-Boom as they would often make requests along the lines of “two more booms, wasn’t paying attention”.

An ursine hybrid with recessive boomalope genes. Lacking intelligence compared to a bear while also missing out on some strength and confidence in hunting. However, they can be commanded to detonate a limited amount of fuel sacks for increased combat versatility in exchange for hurting themselves intentionally.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All primary bear hybrids have stun attacks. The "Detonate chemfuel" ability can be used to cause a powerful "Bomb" damage type explosion surrounding the hybrid. Bear in mind (pun intended) that this will damage the hybrid too!

这是一种不寻常的特质组合，受到一位痴迷于让事物爆炸的特定客户的青睐。赢得了“Boom-Boom”的绰号，因为它们经常提出“再来两个繁荣，没注意”之类的请求。

带有隐性繁荣基因的熊科杂种。与熊相比缺乏智力，同时也失去了一些狩猎的力量和信心。然而，他们可以被命令引爆有限数量的燃料袋，以增加战斗的多功能性，以换取故意伤害自己。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color>所有初级熊混种都有眩晕攻击。 “引爆化学燃料”能力可用于在混合动力周围引起强大的“炸弹”伤害型爆炸。请记住（双关语），这也会损坏混合动力车！

text:
A surprisingly clean animal dubbed the “owl-bear” by those that find them amusing as they attempt to fly by rapidly flapping their stubby vestigial wings. That is until they get their eyes pecked out and flattened by their weight.

An ursine hybrid with recessive avian genes. Slightly dumber but easier to train, they lay eggs every couple of days and have the strength to protect their clutch. Slower than a bear but their ability to hover over terrain means they perform better in harsh terrain.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All primary bear hybrids have stun attacks. Although too heavy to fly, it can use its wings to nullify terrain movement costs.

这是一种出奇干净的动物，被那些觉得有趣的人称为“猫头鹰熊”，因为它们试图通过快速拍打粗短的退化翅膀来飞翔。直到它们的眼睛因体重而被啄出并变平。

具有隐性鸟类基因的熊科杂种。它们稍微笨一些，但更容易训练，每隔几天产卵一次，并且有足够的力量保护自己的幼崽。比熊慢，但它们能够在地形上盘旋，这意味着它们在恶劣的地形中表现更好。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color>所有初级熊混种都有眩晕攻击。虽然太重而无法飞行，但它可以利用翅膀来抵消地形移动成本。

text:
A wonderful animal for those cold winter journeys, very popular as travellers snuggle into their fur at night to keep warm. Fights have even broken out over who gets to sleep with the oversized rug.

An ursine hybrid with recessive muffalo genes. Very filthy but a decently intelligent pack animal that produces good-quality wool and milk. Performs very well in cold environments and is more than capable of defending itself.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All primary bear hybrids have stun attacks.

这种动物非常适合寒冷的冬季旅行，非常受欢迎，因为旅行者在晚上依偎在它们的皮毛中取暖。甚至 破裂 还为谁能睡在超大地毯上而争吵不休。

带有隐性野牛基因的熊科杂种。非常肮脏，但非常聪明的群居动物，能生产优质的羊毛和牛奶。在寒冷的环境中表现非常好，并且有能力自卫。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color>所有初级熊混种都有眩晕攻击。

text:
Great care must be taken before considering raising this chonky boy, as they have a metabolism that matches their high ferocity and movement speed. Pretty useful in keeping egg-laying animal populations in check.

An ursine hybrid with recessive canine genes. A very fierce and intelligent combat hybrid with an incredible appetite. As they are almost constantly hungry, they will dig for berries when they’re hungry provided it’s growing season.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All primary bear hybrids have stun attacks.

在考虑抚养这个笨重的男孩之前必须非常小心，因为他们的新陈代谢与其高凶猛和运动速度相匹配。对于控制产卵动物数量非常有用。

具有隐性犬基因的熊科杂种。一种非常凶猛、聪明的战斗混合体，有着令人难以置信的胃口。由于它们几乎一直处于饥饿状态，因此在生长季节，它们会在饥饿时挖掘浆果。

<color=#E5E54C>游戏效果：</color>所有初级混种熊都有眩晕攻击。

text:
Not many people get to see a naked bear, and fewer still want a repeat viewing. This oversized mole-rat inspires plenty of fear with its massive teeth, but gets a lot of love and affection from those wanting a large, hairless pet that gnaws on the furniture.

An ursine hybrid with recessive rodent genes. Very slow both mentally and physically along with dietary restrictions, but very fierce in combat and immune to pain. Also they have the added benefit of having a short reproductive cycle, low metabolism and being completely fearless in hunting prey.

<color=#E5E54C>Gameplay effect:</color> All primary bear hybrids have stun attacks. No pain sensitivity. This hybrid won't be knocked down in combat due to pain.

能看到裸体熊的人并不多，想要重复观看的人也更少。这种超大的鼹鼠因其巨大的牙齿而引起人们的恐惧，但也受到那些想要一只啃咬家具的大型无毛宠物的人们的喜爱和喜爱。

text:
A tracked, armoured fighting vehicle, the Badger is designed to transport scouts and infantry while providing covering fire to suppress enemy troops. Reinforced side armour plating, ability to deploy blindsmoke and a powerful anti-infantry automated gun make it a powerful vehicle in small combat engagement. It’s relatively vulnerable to attacks from behind, and the short range of the turret means it is outclassed by most designated tanks.

Compared to previous generations, this IFV is designed to quickly drop infantry off at a desired location and provide light covering fire. Lack of armor piercing on fired projectiles make it weak against enemy tanks.

text:
More of a movable mini-base than a deployment pod, Goliath is an expensive but powerful solution to any immovable enemy object. Equipped with four military turret stations and a long range rocket swarm turret at the top, this siege pod is capable of raining fire in 360 degree radius. Nearly impenetrable, it can serve as a portable base of operations, keeping all troops inside safe.

It’s incredibly heavy and lift off requires single-use boosters that separate once the trajectory and velocity is reached. In order to lift off again, the boosters need to be rebuilt.

Being a flying vehicle, it is extremely obvious when on the move.

他们白天寻找食物和住所，晚上战斗躲避寒冷和危险。

现在，他们开始组成一个简单的团体，互相帮助，面对未来的艰难世界。他们正在迈出成为部落的第一步，试图让彼此的生活变得不那么艰难。

questDescription->The great collapse of [empire_name] was a historic event, one that changed the course of this planet. The once-majestic Imperial flagship, a testament to the Empire's technological prowess, now lies wrecked in a secluded location.
\nThe debris from this massive ship is scattered across miles of treacherous terrain. Though shattered and dormant, it is believed that buried within its molten metallic embrace lies the last of the imperial technology - techprints, unique devices, and possibly even machinery not yet seen by the world. The potential for advancement, and perhaps dominance, is high for whoever can harness these forgotten wonders.

text:
Hired by an urbworld magnate with a thirst for thrilling holovid content, your mission was as perilous as it was lucrative. Armed to the teeth, your squad plunges from orbit in experimental hellpods, targeting a land swarming with deadly insectoids. The promise of a hefty payday made the risk worthwhile - until you discovered the magnate's treacherous plan to stiff you.
As the hellpods streak towards the surface, your trajectory locks onto a semi-developed insectoid hive colony. Expect fierce resistance, but if you triumph, the area teems with resources ripe for establishing a base - either a temporary haven or a long-term stronghold.
You’re aware that survival isn’t guaranteed for all, but with the element of surprise on your side, the odds tilt ever so slightly in your favor.

Note: Since you start inside an insectoid megahive, this is a difficult scenario.

当地狱豆冲向地表时，你的轨迹锁定在一个半发育的昆虫蜂巢群上。预计会有激烈的抵抗，但如果你获胜，该地区就会充满建立基地的成熟资源 - 无论是临时避难所还是长期据点。
你知道并不能保证所有人都能生存，但由于你身边有出其不意的因素，胜算稍微对你有利。

注意：由于你是在一个昆虫巨型蜂巢内开始的，所以这是一个困难的场景。

text:
Hired by an urbworld magnate with a thirst for thrilling holovid content, your mission was as perilous as it was lucrative. Armed to the teeth, your squad plunges from orbit in experimental hellpods, targeting a land swarming with deadly insectoids. The promise of a hefty payday made the risk worthwhile - until you discovered the magnate's treacherous plan to stiff you.

As the hellpods streak towards the surface, your trajectory locks onto a semi-developed insectoid hive colony. Expect fierce resistance, but if you triumph, the area teems with resources ripe for establishing a base - either a temporary haven or a long-term stronghold.

You’re aware that survival isn’t guaranteed for all, but with the element of surprise on your side, the odds tilt ever so slightly in your favor.

text: An incredibly rare and monstrously large insectoid of the Sorne geneline, the empress insectoid is incredibly effective at birthing offspring. Her specialized larval chambers allow her to spawn large swarms of swarmlings quickly. While she's not as dangerous in close quarters, the vast numbers of her offspring can easily swarm and overwhelm enemies. While all insectoids are almost equally terrifying, many who have seen the empress find the sight of her even more disturbing, as she embodies all that is wrong with genetic engineering. Upon death, it’s possible to extract a Sorne pherocore from her body.

If uranium ever runs out, the reactor will shut down and will need to be refilled with a large quantity of uranium to restart. The core suffers wear and tear with each uranium unit broken down, and will require continuous maintenance, as lack of it will result in a catastrophic nuclear detonation. Originally designed by {InventorFullName}, these ARCs are incredibly rare, but also versatile and powerful. It’s an advanced generator type that can be upgraded to accept other fuel types, unlocking powerful new abilities. It can be put into an overdrive mode, burning more fuel but generating more power. Fuel rods can also be calibrated to permanently reduce the rate at which uranium decays. This reactor can operate in one of two modes: basic safe mode, or hazard mode, in which maintenance does not lower when uranium is broken down, but radiation leaks out of the core affecting everyone in a large radius. Emergency shut-down systems are also in place, allowing the reactor to stop at any point in order to prevent a critical meltdown. Must be placed on a steam geyser and can only be constructed and upgraded by colonists who have studied a husk of a nuclear ARC generator.

text:
questDescription->After analyzing the data from both black boxes, we have finally pinpointed the location of the last ship fragment - home to the legendary cryptoforge. This ancient ultratech workshop contains the lost knowledge and equipment necessary to craft cryptogear, a technology long thought to be impossible to recreate by any other means. This is our only chance to forge such items, so we must bring our best crafters and as many resources as possible.

The cryptoforge requires an immense amount of power to function, but the crash site still contains a dormant cryptogenerator. While it survived the descent, it only has enough fuel to run for 48 hours. Once activated, it will begin a countdown to meltdown, wiping the entire fragment from the planet’s surface, along with the cryptoforge. This limited time frame means we must work quickly, crafting as much cryptogear as possible before the generator’s collapse. Enabling the cryptogenerator will also reactivate the ship’s ancient defensive turrets, providing much-needed protection against the mechanoids that will inevitably arrive, drawn to the massive energy surge.

Beyond the cryptoforge, the ship’s interior appears remarkably intact. The sealed structure has preserved valuable resources, food, and medicine, as well as functional sleeping quarters, a recreation area, and other remnants of cryptoforge technology. The environment will still be harsh, but the cryptogenerator will power the ship’s heaters and lights, making the space more suitable for extended work. One cryptosleep casket remains occupied, whoever is inside has been frozen for centuries. Freeing them could prove useful, though it is not essential to our mission.

This is our one and only opportunity. Once the generator melts down, the cryptoforge and its secrets will be lost forever. We must establish a strong defense, make the most of our limited time, and craft as much legendary cryptogear as possible before the clock runs out.

translated:
questDescription->分析了两个黑匣子的数据后，我们终于查明了最后一块船碎片的位置——传说中的加密铸造厂的所在地。这个古老的超技术车间包含失落的知识和制造加密装备所需的设备，长期以来人们认为这种技术无法通过任何其他方式重新创造。这是我们锻造此类物品的唯一机会，因此我们必须带上最好的工匠和尽可能多的资源。

加密铸造厂需要大量的电力才能运行，但崩溃站点仍然包含一个休眠的加密发生器。虽然它在下降过程中幸存下来，但它的燃料只够运行 48 小时。一旦激活，它将开始熔化倒计时，从行星表面抹去整个碎片以及加密熔炉。有限的时间意味着我们必须快速工作，在发电机崩溃之前制造出尽可能多的加密装备。启用密码生成器还将重新激活飞船古老的防御炮塔，提供急需的保护，防止不可避免地到来的、被巨大能量激增所吸引的机械人。

在密码铸造之外，飞船的内部看起来非常完好。这个密封的结构保存了宝贵的资源、食物和药品，以及功能性的睡眠区、休闲区和其他加密技术的残余物。环境仍然很恶劣，但加密发电机将为船上的加热器和灯供电，使该空间更适合长时间工作。一个加密睡眠棺材仍然被占用，里面的人都已经被冰冻了几个世纪。释放他们可能会很有用，尽管这对于我们的任务来说并不是必需的。

这是我们唯一的机会。一旦发电机熔化，加密铸造厂及其秘密将丢失永远。我们必须建立强大的防御，充分利用有限的时间，在时间耗尽之前制造尽可能多的传奇加密装备。

text:
Oppression breeds defiance. For years, your village toiled under the weight of crushing taxes and hunger while the lord’s knights took everything: grain, livestock, even your last scraps of dignity. When they seized your final stores of food, desperation turned to rage.

Armed with nothing but fury, you march upon the castle where the lord and his knights hide behind stone walls. You are weak, but sheer numbers and resolve may turn the tide. Should you triumph, the castle’s wealth and security could be yours.

But not all believe in victory. Some whisper of escape, of slipping away before the slaughter begins. Beyond the walls lies an uncertain world, one that promises danger but also the chance for a new life. Will you fight to take the castle, or flee and forge your own path?
Note: Since you start around an enemy castle, this is a difficult scenario.

translated:
压迫滋生反抗。多年来，你的村庄在沉重的税收和饥饿的重压下辛苦劳作，而领主的骑士则夺走了一切：粮食、牲畜，甚至是你最后一点尊严。当他们夺取了你最后的食物时，绝望变成了愤怒。

除了愤怒之外，你什么都没有武装，向城堡进军，领主和他的骑士们躲在石墙后面。你很弱，但纯粹的人数和决心可能会扭转局势。如果您取得胜利，城堡的财富和安全就属于您。

但并非所有人都相信胜利。一些窃窃私语的逃跑，在屠杀开始之前溜走。墙外是一个不确定的世界，这个世界充满危险，但也有新生活的机会。你会奋战夺取城堡，还是逃跑并开辟自己的道路？
注意：由于你是从敌人的城堡开始的，所以这是一个困难的场景。

text: story->This vault is guarded by a loyal group of friends. The underground halls once contained a gifted patient with the ability to manipulate her form. She could transform into anything on a whim. The doctors would bring out turtles and rabbits to test her skill, and through a painful melting process she was able to form a shell and become unmistakably a turtle. Overtime, this process became too grueling to tolerate. She was well-liked among the other patients, and they ended up taking great pity on her. On one night, they convinced the girl to melt into the form of a doctor to stage a breakout. She managed to bring all her friends to the vault door in her disguise, but was said to have instead accidentally unleashed a wave of the failed genetic horrors. text:
Detonation of Deadlife dust warheads in the upper atmosphere has permanently altered planetary conditions. A dense death pall now blankets the world.

This pall reanimates all unburied corpses exposed to the open air. Any non-mechanoid corpse not under a roof will rise again as a shambler. Burned or fully destroyed corpses are unaffected.

While the death pall is active, no normal weather transitions can occur. Rain will not fall, and fires may spread unchecked.

On a global scale, the death pall will linger for anywhere from three seasons to several years. In its wake, roaming Shambler hordes will now traverse the world, overrunning settlements and hunting down caravans.

questDescription->We have intercepted a broadcast at a recently raided underground silo: Operation: Deadlife is now underway. Enough resource silos have been breached, and the plan has been set in motion. The broadcast confirms that [General_nameFull] has initiated final preparations at an ancient ICBM launch site.

Refueling of the devastating missiles is in progress. These warheads are armed with deadlife dust payloads and if launched, they will detonate high in orbit, spreading a near-permanent death pall across the planet. It is likely that endless hordes of shamblers will then scour the world, consuming or destroying all remaining civilization.

We have traced the origin of the signal to the ICBM launch facility. We must travel there and stop [General_nameFull] before the launch sequence can be completed. The site is expected to be heavily defended, not only swarming with shamblers, but also protected by restored automated defenses.

[General_nameFull] will activate numerous defensive systems from the facility’s control room: opening sealed death pits, releasing shambler animals from containment kennels, flooding the complex with rotstink gas, and awakening elite deadlife officers from cryogenic caskets.

Only by reaching and destroying the launch terminal can we prevent the missiles from firing. Failure to stop the launch in time, or ignoring this threat entirely, will doom the planet to a global shambler apocalypse.

This is our only chance to end Operation: Deadlife once and for all.

questDescription->我们在最近突袭的一个地下发射井中截获了一段广播：“死亡行动”正在进行中。足够的资源孤岛已经被突破，并且该计划已经启动。广播确认[General_nameFull]已在古老的洲际弹道导弹发射场开始最后准备工作。

毁灭性导弹的加油正在进行中。这些弹头配备了致命尘埃有效载荷，一旦发射，它们将在轨道高处爆炸，在地球上散布近乎永久的死亡阴影。随后，无数的流浪者很可能会席卷世界，吞噬或摧毁所有剩余的文明。

我们已将信号的来源追溯到洲际弹道导弹发射设施。我们必须前往那里并 停止 [General_nameFull] 才能完成发射序列。该地点预计将受到严密防守，不仅挤满了漫步者，而且还受到恢复的自动化防御的保护。

[General_nameFull]将从设施的控制室激活众多防御系统：打开密封的死亡坑，从收容所中释放漫步者动物，用腐臭气体淹没整个建筑群，并将精英死亡官员从低温中唤醒

只有到达并摧毁发射终端才能阻止导弹发射。如果未能及时停止发射，或者完全忽视这一威胁，地球将注定陷入全球性的灾难。

这是我们一劳永逸地结束“死亡行动”的唯一机会。
